products.description:
Product Description

With the PlayStation 3 160GB system, you get free PlayStation Network membership, built-in Wi-Fi and 160GB of hard disk drive storage for games, music, videos and photos. This system will come with firmware 3.6 or greater. You can easily upgrade to the latest firmware for free, simply by connecting the PS3 to the internet. And every PS3 system comes with a built-in Blu-ray player to give you pristine picture quality and the best high-definition viewing experience available. Whether it’s gaming, Blu-ray movies, music or online services, experience it all with the PlayStation 3 system. All PlayStation 3 systems are already equipped with everything you need to play stereoscopic 3D games.

Amazon.com

The fourth generation of hardware released for the PlayStation 3 entertainment platform, the PlayStation 3 160GB system is the next stage in the evolution of Sony's console gaming powerhouse. Loaded with a mix of multimedia features and functions available on earlier PlayStation 3 models, as well as a series of new advancements and refinements, the PlayStation 3 160GB system is destined to push the envelope in the realm of Next-Generation entertainment. .caption { font-family: Verdana, Helvetica neue, Arial, serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic; } ul.indent { list-style: inside disc; text-indent: -15px; } table.callout { font-family: verdana; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1. 3em; } td.vgoverview { height: 125px; background: #9DC4D8 url(https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/images/G/01/electronics/detail-page/callout-bg.png) repeat-x; border-left: 1px solid #999999; border-right: 1px solid #999999; padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; padding-bottom: 10px; width: 250px; font-family: verdana; font-size: 12px; }

What's Under the Hood

As with previous models, the PlayStation 3 160GB system features an IBM "Cell" processor and a co-developed NVIDIA graphics processor that together allow the system to perform two trillion calculations per second. Yet the 160GB system manages to improve on this with its 45nm version of the processor, which although running at the same 60+nm speed as previous PS3 versions, uses less energy. This makes the unit's smaller size and quieter fan possible. Along with the traditional AV and composite connections, the 160GB system also boasts an HDMI (High-Definition Multimedia Interface) port, which delivers uncompressed, unconverted digital picture and sound to compatible high-definition TVs and projectors. (The system is capable of 128-bit pixel precision and 1080p resolution for a full HD experience) This console also provides for an extreme sound experience by supporting Dolby Digital 5.1, DTS 5.1, as well as Linear PCM 7.1. Finally, it features cross connectivity with your PC network and PlayStation Portable (PSP) and its pre-installed, 160GB hard disc drive allows you to save games as well as download content from The Internet. Unlike other models of the PlayStation 3, the 160GB system does not offer backwards compatibility.

Blu-ray, PlayStation Network Downloads and Beyond

PlayStation 3 utilizes the Blu-ray disc media format, which gives you the best high-definition viewing experience on your television, by way of the format's ability to hold six times as much data as traditional DVDs. This tremendous capacity, combined with the awesome power of the system's processor and graphics card, promises an endless stream of mind-blowing games, and other multimedia content. However, this does not mean that the PS3 is limited to Blu-ray discs - it also supports CD-ROM, CD-RW, DVD, DVD-ROM, DVD-R, DVD+R formats. In addition, PlayStation 3 system software includes BD Live support that allows you to play discs that support Blu-ray Disc Profile 2.0 (BD-LIVE). This means that you can also connect to the Internet while playing discs that support this format to obtain additional features. Of course, PS3 owners also receive free access to the PlayStation Network (PSN), where through the PlayStation Store and PlayStation Home, they can download games, game demos, movies, and other content, as well as chat with friends, play mini-games, compete in tournaments and explore dedicated game spaces.

Sensational Controller

The Dualshock 3 wireless controller(one controller) included with The PlayStation 3 160GB system provides the most intuitive gameplay experience, with pressure sensors in each action button and the inclusion of the highly sensitive Sixaxis motion-sensing technology. Each hit, crash, and explosion is more realistic when the user feels the rumble right in the palm of their hand. It can even detect natural movements for real-time and high precision interactive play, acting as a natural extension of the user’s body. Dualshock 3 utilizes Bluetooth technology for wireless game play and the controller’s detachable USB cable to seamlessly and automatically charge the controller when connected to the PlayStation 3. By integrating all of these features into the popular PlayStation controller design, the Dualshock 3 further enhances the advanced gameplay experience only available on the PlayStation 3 system.

Synch with Your Other Sony HDMI Devices

The PlayStation 3 160GB system features HDMI + Bravia Synch functionality. Bravia Synch allows connectivity between Sony HDMI products without having to utilize multiple remote controls. This means that with the push of one button, users can control compliant Sony devices connected to your PS3 via HDMI cable.

They served their purpose, but I think I am going to go with the silicone nursing pads you can reuse and won't leave lines or stick to ya painfully! For the price, they are worth it though. They do what they need to do for a cheap price! I always kept some stashed in the diaper bag to use. A small annoyance is that they have tons of little paper tabs once you've peeled off to apply. I always found them laying around somewhere cause they'd escape my hand when I took them to the trash. Seriously, they are little houdini papers! They absorbed quite a bit too! There were some times I wasn't able to nurse right away and I'd lose a decent amount of milk and not one leak!

reviews.title: Quilting is melded dotted lamination of vinyl waterproofing sandwiched between two layers of soft polyester
reviews.body: Much nicer than expected, the [[ASIN:B00MUZVKY8 American Baby Company Waterproof Fitted Quilted Crib and Toddler Protective Pad Cover, White]] fits very well and it is quite soft to the touch.  Now a sheet covers this protective pad, but having it soft is appreciated.  I don't know what I was expecting for the side fabric, but it is a very stretchy woven material that is lightweight and can be caught on things if you're not careful.  We will be careful.  It sort of reminds me of loosely woven nurse stockings of decades ago.  I very much like this sheeting and likely will purchase this brand when it's time to get a pad for a twin size bed.  It was manufactured in China by a California corporation and can be machine washed in cold water without bleach using a gentle cycle and a tumble dry low.  I prefer hanging these to dry because I want it to last longer, so it's a good idea to have a backup ready for daily use.  Since it's underneath the sheet, I'm not concerned about light staining as long as I know it's clean.  I see that it is also offered in a cotton version, the [[ASIN:B000BUQNXW American Baby Company Waterproof Quilted Cotton Crib & Toddler Mattress Pad Cover, White]], so if you need the natural fiber, there you go.  I have not seen it, so cannot comment on that more expensive version.

reviews.title: Best Arm To Side Swaddle, But Please Read
reviews.body:
I want to explain why this is the best of its kind BUT NOT what I would personally use next time... I know this is long (it is the longest review I ever wrote only because I deeply care).
When I was an arm to side swaddler I loved HALO, this was definitely my top pick, it is very easy to put on, super easy to change a diaper and almost impossible to get out of. The fabric is soft and easy to care of.
As for any swaddler you want to make sure child has enough space to move, fold, straighten his legs freely, with HALO he definitely does.
The velcro is very long making it easy to control size and tightness, and it's not loud if you would like to keep a sleeping child asleep lol
Another great feature is the transition part of it... you can swaddle only one arm or no arms at all, do it one night one arm at first to get your child use to not being swaddled.
So for all those reasons and more HALO is the best if you want to swaddle your child with his arms to the side, BUT I would be very careful if you choose this option, since if a child rolls over it can bad very badly (read one of the bad reviews here, this is a very sad story which I wish never happened, God rest that little boys soul). I know you might think that it would never happen to you, but why take the chance when there is something better and safer out there?
Again, this is only my opinion and I am almost sure HALO is safe for the first couple of months when a neborn can't roll over to his stomach, I would probably keep using HALO until first signs of rolling over if I didn't know better.
Everything changed when I found Love To Dream, it took me a while to decide I wanna try it since it just looked weird, but all the great reviews and the fact the baby can be on his stomach convinced me. Tried it, both baby and I loved it, baby rolled over a few times with it and was able to hold her head high and cry for hating to be on the stomach... anyway that's what it would use next time from the beginning, does the job of keeping baby secure and giving me the ease of knowing baby is safe.

The zipper zips from the top to the bottom to allow the babies vital wires to easily come out the bottom of the sack away from their little fingers. My son came home on oxygen and I bought two more sleep sacks. It allowed me to swaddle my newborn and keep him warm without fear of it becoming undone like a blanket might. reviews.title: Really pampers?
reviews.body: I just used this product after having posted a good review. I have used these wipes on and off for years. I had no idea how much they skimped and changed them until now.  They are so thin you can see through them. You'd better use at least 2 per wipe unless you want poop on your fingers. Some things Americans are willing to pay more for. I'd rather pay a quarter more for a quality wipe. We save nothing if we must use 2 or 3 wipes at a time. I hope the CEO of this company is caught out with their grandbaby, a huge blowout and only 2 wipes left. Shame on you!!

reviews.title: Good Wipes, Terrible Packaging
reviews.body: Okay, I'm really conflicted on these wipes.  I've used Pampers Sensitive for years because of some issues with Huggies wipes causing rashes on two of my kids when they were little.  But, as a father of five, I have had a lot of wipes brands over the years.  These have a great scent, and don't dry my hands out as much as the sensitive ones.  But they also come in the worst packaging ever.  THERE IS NO PLASTIC THING!!!  What I mean is that you have to use these with a wipes box.  A pack of sensitive wipes will stay moist in my car in Florida for months (that's 150+ degrees inside the car in the summer) and in the house for years (we've found some that were years old).  You open, use, and reseal!  These wipes can't reseal so you must use a container.  We had a container with the first kids, and then another, and then another.  All of them dried wipes up in a few weeks, so we stopped using them.  I don't know anyone else who uses a container, everyone just uses the resealable package that the wipes come in.  I can only assume that Pampers is trying to sell boxes, but that won't work on me.  I cut the packages open carefully and resealed with tape this time.  But I won't buy these again as a result.  : (

reviews.title: I was very pleased with this carrier - so much so that although ...
reviews.body:
I was very pleased with this carrier - so much so that although it didn't fit, I bought a medium and kept this one for my mother to use with the twins. Fit - I am 5'1", ~135 lbs (closer to 150 when I tried this on a few weeks after getting home from the hospital), and a medium fits perfectly. My mom is 5', ~115 lbs and the small was comfortable for her.  One of my twins absolutely LOVED this carrier (the other liked it, too, but not to the same degree). She loves being carried in general, and was so fussy the first few months whenever she wasn't being held that having this carrier was a life saver!  I have this as well as a Moby, and although I did like that the Moby had more options for wrapping methods and can give a more customized fit, I love the ease of use of the K'tan. It is literally less than a minute to wrap them, which is wonderful - the last thing I want is to be messing around with the tails on a huge piece of fabric trying to remember if this piece goes under or over while they're gearing up to full melt-down. Plus it's very compact and easy to throw in the car or my purse or diaper bag in case I need it wherever we're going, and I can even just throw it on like a scarf just in case (not the most fashion-forward piece, but for convenience you really can't beat it). The color of this carrier is really lovely, too, and the fabric is very soft and cuddly. The first few months, my LO fell asleep almost immediately every single time I carried her.
K'tan vs. Moby: the only time I would recommend buying a Moby over a K'tan is if two people of very different sizes each want to wear the baby, and both are willing to learn how to wrap (that is a biggie - my hubby was willing to wear, but didn't want to learn the Moby). Otherwise I would choose the K'tan, every time.
Some comments:
If you're going to carry for more than an hour, or carry a few times per day, you may have a sore back afterwards. This is fairly comfortable, but does not offer as much back support as a soft structured carrier (SCC) would, as all of the weight is still on your upper body. I used this carrier almost exclusively for the first few months and would again if we had more babies, but now that my babies are bigger (>15 lbs) I prefer to use an SCC if I am going to carry them around for a bit. However, with that said, I still use this carrier when my clingy baby is super fussy and tired, and it still works like a charm. Love, love, Love my K'tan!
Finally, if you're debating different carriers, I highly recommend going to a Babywearing International (BWI) meeting ([...]). There are chapters in most major cities, and they will let you bring your baby and try on different carriers from their lending libraries for free, so you can figure out what carriers work best for you and your baby before buying. Plus, if you pay $30 a year for a membership, you can rent a carrier each month, which is a great way to try before you buy.

reviews.title: Very sturdy, Easy to install, Perhaps a tripping hazard.
reviews.body:
I just needed a barrier to "remind" a dog that he can't go into our bedroom and didn't want the inconvenience of either stepping over a barrier or having to remove and replace the expandable type. This swing open gate is perfect and the option of a pressure installation meant it was both easy to install and non-destructive to the door frame; for installation to keep a toddler off the stairs you should use the 4 screw-in wall cups, but even those would be minimally destructive (one screw hole per cup). The 4 pressure pads fit into the wall cups, which prevent the pressure pads from sliding along the wall if the gate is really pushed hard.

Pros:
Very sturdy
self-closing, but will stay open at 90 degrees (note, they make a similar, not-self-closing version if you don't like this function)
latches easily and securely
swings both ways
Easy to install
two install options - pressure (suitable for non-critical locations) or screwed in place wall cups (for critical safety locations)

Con:
There is a metal bar across the bottom of the gate that connects the left and right side pieces. This bar is needed since the gate is not actually attached to the walls but is held in place by pressure. This bar, while thin, does present a tripping hazard until you get used to it. It would be particularly hazardous at the top of a flight of stairs.

reviews.body:
I paid full price, no discount or free item for a review.
Honestly I was surprised by the quality. They are thick, well stitched, nice padding in the pee zone (actually looks a lot like a menstrual pad strip and as thick as a 'heavy flow' one. very soft and bright, cute designs. They do run a bit large when compared to what my child wears in pant size (4T and 5T regular pants/underwear, but the 4T in these were over his navel, 1/2 way up his back and sagged a bit).  I kept them for the fall growth spurt and just ordered a 3T set. They hold a couple of full-bladder accidents so would hold up well overnight if your child didn't drink a gallon of water! They breathe unlike a disposable overnight/diaper so no sweaty summer rash. They are not overtly bulky (unless kid is wearing tights) so they would work just as well as regular underwear after potty training. But..is any kid really fully accident free until age 6/7?? hekc, some adults aren't- so why risk the sheets, embarrassment, odor at night or on vacations/slumberparties (if covid ever ends). If your child is thin, these could well be used a period underwear for girls (yes they can start early as age 8)!

It's tall enough that my pit mix can't jump over it, and is strong enough to handle the puppies pushing against it when they see me outside. It's a really nice color and style, and looks clean with the hardwood and other dark features of our house. It is made of metal instead of plastic and isn't nearly as flimsy as some of the cheaper gates. The extensions are nice for adjusting to different doorway sizes and the rubber stops are easy to tighten and loosen as needed. Just don't lose them! It's easy to forget about them rolling around when you remove the gate for an extended period of time. I would definitely recommend this to any pet parent looking for a sleek solution to corralling their tiny beasts!

reviews.title: 5 stars for the seat, 1 star for my daughter not liking it.
reviews.body:
When my daughter goes to daycare, she sometimes sits on the Bumbo seat they have. When I had the opportunity to order one for our own place, I jumped on it and couldn't wait for it to arrive. My daughter is about to hit 5 months, so I thought we may as well start having her sit up often. Plus, it'd be funny seeing such a tiny person sit in such a large living room.

When it arrived, I was taken aback by how heavy and sturdy it was. Indeed, the quality exceeded my expectations, and I was relieved to find it had the built-in seatbelt after meeting the recall corrections. However, when I put my daughter in, it took only a few minutes before she started squealing. I thought she was uncomfortable, so I shifted her around a bit, but she wouldn't be pacified. I tried again a few days later, but the same result. At the moment, it doesn't seem like she likes her own Bumbo very much. She currently has a diaper rash, so I'll try sitting her on the seat again once the rash's gone.

I looked again at the one at her daycare, and I realized it has the optional tray, which was used to prop up a mirror to keep her occupied while sitting. So I added the tray in my Amazon Registry and hope it'll distract her from concentrating on what she's sitting. I wish the seat actually came with it.

Otherwise, the seat itself seems great. It's built sturdily out of a foam material rather than a hard plastic as I initially thought, but is heavy enough with a seatbelt to keep my daughter from toppling over.

Hopefully she grows to like it, but not to the point where she no longer will fit in it.

Since the placement for it is right in front of baby's face when facing forward, I can imagine he isn't the only baby who has spit up or drooled in this thing. If your baby is extra slobbery or spits up from reflux, I would recommend putting the piano on the bottom. I love how easy it is to take apart to clean. The fabric on the seat comes off easily, and even removing the seat frame is easy. The clear window does get a little grimy looking from baby fingers. It would be nice if that part could be removed for cleaning. All of the toys seem to be fun for my 5 month old so far. We have also attached other suction cup toys to the top from time to time to switch things up. Also, we attach teething rings to the loops on the seat. reviews.title: Remove the rattle immediately
reviews.body:
The rattle is annoyingly loud if you are standing a few feet away. If you are right next to it (your baby) it can cause hearing damage. I measured 103.3 decibels. What were they thinking!?

Those of you (and there are many) that have no audio coming from the electronics anymore: there is a fix. You will have to take the cloud apart and replace the speaker with a new one that is 8 ohms and 0.25 watt. These are dirt cheap and usually sold in packs for a few dollars. My replacement was slightly bigger and would not fit correctly but I was still able to stuff it in there and get it working. You will need a soldering iron.

I have a collection of around eight different polyfill-stuffed travel pillows that I’ve accumulated over the years, and I recently acquired a new travel pillow that is stuffed with shredded memory foam. The new one has no pillowcase, and the zippered pillowcases on my old pillows were looking rather faded, so I searched on Amazon for zippered pillowcases of appropriate size and came upon this very popular brand.

I tested the two pillowcases that came as a set with this purchase on one of my old pillows and my much plumper, new, memory-foam pillow. I am happy to report that this pillowcase works equally well for both types of travel pillows. I simply had to go to a little bit more effort with the fluffy memory-foam pillow by carefully mashing it down to get it to squeeze inside this zippered cover. Once I got it inside, I was able to easily zip the cover shut.

Both pillows look great inside these attractive pillowcases. I got the red color, which is a lovely, bright, clear red. I am so pleased with these pillow cases, in fact, I just ordered some more in different colors so I can re-cover all my old travel pillows.

reviews.title: Great portable toy
reviews.body:
We have had a variety of these sorts of toys, but they have all been the type that you set up and can't break down easily. The kids love them, but they take up soooo much room. I've never seen one before that is so portable. This is great not only because you can take it with you places, but also because you can set it up and take it down when you use it in the house so you don't always have this huge thing in the middle of your living room or wherever you keep it.

Now this toy (and others like it) are only good for a short period of time. The baby needs to be able to support his head and usually when the baby starts walking and being very mobile they lose interest. Still, it is so invaluable during that time that I still think it's worth it. It gives you a place to put the baby while you eat or are trying to clean or do something else. This one comes with different toys like a rattle, teether, mirror book and spinner seat. The baby can also just in it, which she likes. You don't keep a baby in it for hours, but it is something good to entertain the baby for a little while. I do always supervise the baby while she is in it, of course. It is not meant to be a safe place to leave them alone like a crib.

Again, the portability it great. If you are going on vacation, this would definitely be something to take with you. It is good for grandma's house or really anywhere. It is really nice that it has a sun shade. This makes it great for the outdoors.

This was easy to use and set up. I am happy with the quality. Summer Infant is a popular company and we have other things from them. I would recommend it.

reviews.title: Folds up easily, good for bouncing or for thoughtful playing with toys
reviews.body:
I've been avoiding getting one of these activity centers for my six month old, just because they take up so much space. When we had one for my son, who is now a toddler, I remember tripping on it numerous times, and that it took up as much space as a lounge chair for an adult, just given that it needed to have so many stabilizing feet and parts sticking out to keep it from falling over. I never understood why that was necessary to take up so much room to seat such a small child.

This is great because it folds up in about 10 seconds to a quarter of its normal size, so I can set it out when I want her to be elevated and in a seat, and quickly fold it up and stick it in the corner of the room when I want to play Legos or something on the floor. While I was initially suspicious of the included toys, my six-month-old actually seems to like all of them. There is a spinning ball that is stuck in place but that can be spun very quickly and when it moves, there are some little balls and things inside that make a minor racket. Everybody likes that, toddler included.

It's also great because not only can she sit in it and play with some of her toys or the included toys, but she can also bounce. Sometimes she is feeling more active and likes to bounce, another time she is feeling more thoughtful and wants to play with the toys. I've been setting her up right next to my desk while I try to get some work done and she likes being close to me and able to see what I can do.

Not only do I like this for inside, but I also like that I can take it on the go and not have to worry about what surface I set her down on. It comes with a little attached piece of cloth that covers whatever floor surface you set the item on. So I can put her outside when we are in the backyard and feel safe that she's not jumping up and down on a spider in the lawn. Or if we go somewhere, I don't have to worry too much about whether the floor surface is pristine.

The included shade is fine, but I live in a mild climate so after putting it on for testing purposes, I immediately took it off. It seems to fold up fine with the unit and wasn't a problem, I just didn't personally need it and so it seemed like it was going to restrict her view unnecessarily.

Overall, if you want to get one of these activity centers but don't want to give over a large portion of living space to one of these things on a constant basis, consider this one. I really like it and given the four-month window of time when it was actually useful to us with our last child, I feel like getting something somewhat minimalist like this is a good plan.

reviews.title: Used it as an extreme tint/toner to get rid of red undertones
reviews.body:
I'm 51. Haven't seen my natural hair color - not more than 2.5" during pandemic, anyway - since I was 19. My natural color is such an extreme ash, it's literally not even a color it's just ash. If 'light charcoal BLONDE' was a color, that'd be mine. And weirdly enough, adding any bleach to my unique natural color would always bring out the red that apparently hides deeeeeeeeeep within (from my daddy's sisters, both redheads). I've used all the toners, all the hair colors, embraced the reds, desperately tried to remove them with every product sold in salons, salon suppliers, Sally's, etc. had every shade of blonde from platinum to dark ultra ash, several shades of brown, you name it. My hair has definitely been good to me, never leaving me no matter how much I abused it 😅 But I am at that stage in my life where I just want to embrace natural color before it turns silver and white. My current color was the dark blonde, very close to my natural color except no amount of product was taking the red out and restoring the world's ashiest ash.

Note: I was nervous and some parts of my hair didn't get left on as long as others. BUT I am so so so so so so happy!! I believe this is as close as it will get while I leave it to grow out now. I did add 1:1 water to the developer, to lessen any bleaching. Again, I was attempting a tint/tone and not a color.

Scent is typical of any other box color, still floral just not as yuck and heavy as others.

reviews.title: Pretty, But More Intense Than I Expected
reviews.body:
I don’t know how anyone else is keeping these things in their hair without clips. I needed clips. They slide all around in my hair. First, I can’t use these from wet to dry hair. My hair just will not ever dry that way. Tried it. I took them out after 8 hours in and my hair was still wet. Second, there aren’t enough rollers for all my hair. You can’t put a ton of hair on these. There are only enough rollers to do the top of my hair. From the top of my ears up. I’d need at least two full sets for my whole head. Third, these mainly just boost volume. Very little curl happening. Fourth, if your hair is longer than shoulder length, it can be difficult to pull your hair straight up and get these on it. Grab a section of your hair. Pull it all the way out away from your head. Can you touch the end? I had some trouble reaching the ends of my hair on the top of my head. (And my hair is just barely past my shoulders.)
So, the proper way to use these, I had found, is to dry your hair. Yep. Dry it. Put the rollers into your dry hair and secure with a long alligator sectioning clip. Spray hair with flexible hold spray OR work a little volume pumping product in before putting the rollers in. Blow dry the dry hair on the rollers for about five minutes. Let them cool for 15 minutes. Remove them. Have big hair.
The secondary, less optimal, but works when I don’t feel like drying my hair all the way. Dry hair most of the way. Put rollers into slightly damp hair, securing with alligator clips. Dry the bottom half of hair with a round brush, since it won’t fit in the rollers. Blow dry the rollers for about 5 minutes. Leave them in for an hour or so. Then remove them and have big hair. The downside to this option is that your hair won’t look as smooth and might still be damp when you remove the rollers.
I’m pretty much thinking my hair is too thick for these bad boys. Or maybe I’m just not dedicated enough to my hair. I don’t know. My hair looks pretty awesome when I use them, but they don’t save me time. They don’t help me to not use the blow dryer, which was what I was hoping for. I was hoping to roll my hair up like a granny and then two hours later have dry hair. Doesn’t work like that.

Foundation, #210 Natural Ochre, Take a look on the product page for the guidelines in selecting the shade that will work for you, it worked for me.

reviews.title: I keep coming back to this Method Sweet Water gel hand soap
reviews.body:
I have liquid soap pump dispensers all over my house in the kitchen all the bathrooms. My dispensers are clear glass and I wanted a clear gel soap on display…so a bit of a minimalist look.

I also am not a fan of fragrances. I think there is supposed to be a slight citrus (grapefruit) fragrance to this, but frankly I never notice it, which is just fine with me.

Like many of us, I wash my hands a lot more now throughout the day. This soap is very gentle on my skin. Normally I might have some dryness around my knuckles, but that’s not really a problem with this soap.

One thing I’ve learned is to be sure you are rinsing soap off your hands well each time you wash them. I think this helps avoid any possible skin irritation.

I try to only buy commonly-used liquid products that have refills to cut down on my heavy plastic recycling. These refill pouches really are very handy. They are light-weight and take up little room…they actually take up less room as you empty the pouch to refill your soap dispenser.

They are easy to hold while refilling your bottle and, as I get low on the product in each bag, I just start at the bottom and keep folding the pouch over and over on itself…squeezing everything last bit out.

I especially like this six-pack of refill pouches so I can have them stored around the house wherever we have soap dispensers. I feel the value is pretty good and I don’t have to worry as often about running out.

I can highly recommend and will continue to keep purchasing this product. Also plenty of other nice fragrances and colors to choose from if that is your preference.

reviews.title: Stinks - smells like RAID house and garden bug killer
reviews.body:
I went with this because I thought it was one I had tried previously with little scent. I don't have that major multiple chemical sensitivities problem some people do but I cannot abide strong fragrance or much fragrance at all. I should have gone with the cucumber. At least it does not smell like a pesticide. It smells like, well cucumber. There are worse things to smell like. Like this.

I couldn't quite place the scent before when I first noticed my hands stink of something. I now have enough soap that smells like RAID house and garden bug killer to last me a lifetime. Maybe it will keep bugs away at least? what  a shame they don't have sniff technology on the web.

I was pleased to find a refill pouch (less plastic to recycle) so that I could re-use my original Method bottle, keeping it full, plus it is less expensive per ounce. The soap has a lovely purple color. When I couldn't find this soap locally, I shopped Amazon. After using the soap for 2 years, I tried other brands of lavender soap (Softsoap as well as store brands) and they smelled too much like sweet perfume. My order contained 6 refill pouches and I plan to give a couple of bags away to my sons.

reviews.title: Tiger Eye is a pretty, natural looking shimmer that feels good on lips
reviews.body:
I have the color, "Tiger Eye", which is a neutral that leans a touch pink. The high shine and touch of sparkle and absence of color gives the lips a perked up lush look without being over done. The gloss feels nice on the lips- not tacky, not sticky, not heavy. It makes my lips feel hydrated and smooth. My lips look healthy and moist. Does this last long? no. But there is no rebound drying effect that some glosses and balms can create.

One thing I tried was swiping it across lip stick. Funny thing, I have a matte color that gets a wow factor when I add this sheer pop of shine across it. SO I think it has some potential for other applications.

For me, it will likely stay a gloss as is. My lips are fairly pink, so just swiping this on real quick is a nice ay to feel a little more put together with very little effort. A nice gloss to toss in the purse or in the pocket for anytime the lips need a little added shine or moisture.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT LIP GLOSS - Misleading Name
reviews.body:
When I read “exhibitionist” I was concerned it was going to be over the top, sparkly or brightly colored but this is anything but that.

I’m not sure why COVERGIRL would put this in a product line with that name as this is definitely an adult product that any conservative woman would be comfortable wearing.  I guess Exhibitionist is one of their primary lines, just seems misleading to us.

The Cheeky Color is a light pink - not too dark but enough pigment to give a nice touch.  Perfect for those who don’t like to wear much makeup.

This is an all around great lipgloss.  Not greasy.  It is not sticky can be applied by itself or over lipstick with no problem.  This is an excellent lipgloss for winter months as it is super hydrating and lasts all day.

Great product.

reviews.title: Absolutely love this!
reviews.body:
I got the color Low Key and I was super nervous that it would be very dark on my lips. Phew bullet dodged! I absolutely LOVE LOVE LOOOOVE how this looks. It is not nearly as dark as it shows in the picture but I guess you could build up to that level of darkness? I didn't try because I wouldn't want that. It has a nice sheen to it with a subtle glitter in it. I find it looks beautiful and is more of a dark tint than a super dark lipstick color on your lips. It was smooth and very nice on your lips which was great. There was not stickiness or anything weird about it.

When I got the applicator out of the tube it had a lovely scent to it, almost like a coconut kind of scent which I really liked a lot. This is great and you can use it on its own or over a lipstick. Sadly it won't last long if you drink tea or coffee but just take it with you and reapply :) Problem solved.

Secondly, it keeps my lips soft and smooth. I live in Florida where the sun and beachside winds can sometimes wreak havoc on my skin. My lips are always feeling dry and this Nivea product, in my opinion, is better than any typical Chapstick ones. Nivea has always been part of my daily skin regime and now I can add lipcare as well. Highly recommend!

reviews.body: There are four lip balms in this box. This moisturizes just like Chapstick or EOS. The color looks rich in the tube but when it goes on it is barely there. It gave my lips a whisper of color with a nice shimmer. Personally, I hate lip balms with color because if I want color, I just wear lipstick.  When I ordered this, I did not realize it had color. However, I love that this color looks deep on "paper" but almost imperceptible on the lips.  The watermelon flavor is nice but also subtle. If this balm only had the shimmer and no color, it would have gotten five stars from me. This is a very good lip moisturizer.

I was really worried after reading some reviews. I haven't noticed any issues thus far. I dont have a history of sensitive skin so I cant speak on that. Would highly recommend to people looking for a natural deodorant.

reviews.title: Lasted me 12 hours until my next shower; surprisingly effective; nice fresh scent
reviews.body:
I usually use nothing but Old Spice Swagger solid with the active ingredient of aluminum zirconium tetrachlorohydrex gly 17%. This Schmidt's solid has no aluminum and only natural ingredients. Usually, products like these only last me about 2-3 hours; however, the protection lasted 12 hours until my next shower. Of course, it is winter, so that might be why.

I take a shower every 12 hours because I sweat a lot, so I can never attest to 48-hour protection. This has a fresh cucumber scent. I would not say it is cucumber but it is lovely. I really love the scent.

This works better than other non-aluminum deodorants I tried previously. The current price of $31.13 comes to an expensive $7.78 per 2.65 ounce solid stick as this is a 4-pack. I would never purchase this due to the high price. However, if the price were more in line with my aluminum deodorant, I would consider it.

reviews.title: Fragrance is overwhelming and chemical to my nose
reviews.body:
There are three 3.25 ounce tubes in this package.

The balm goes on easily and melts (as can be seen from the picture) into the skin from the heat of one's body. I applied this both in the evening after my shower and in the morning after another shower.  This product actually kept me from sleeping well the entire night because the fragrance is incredibly overwhelming and it is also chemical smelling (almost like Raid insect spray) to my nose.  I love fragrance and always feel the more overpowering the better, but not in this case.

This deodorant "protects" as a result of the intense fragrance.  I doubt body odor sweat can overpower this aroma. I personally never get results from any product except those that contain 17% or more of aluminum. Nevertheless, I can attest that it produces results and a "scent" headache in my case.

This is not for me. The price of $21.98 is competitive for three. Since a lot is dispensed as it easily melts on during application, it will probably not last as long as other deodorant.

reviews.title: Hardest working deodorant Ive found in a long time!!
reviews.body:
In a world where mega name brands rule the anti-perspirant industry.. yet, seem to have forgotten the recipe to making a solid, stand up, hard-working deodorant!! It’s a bit surprising to find the solution in a smaller name like Schmidt… But, boy did they hit it out of the park with this one!

As one who needs a working deodorant for adults, teenage boy and college athlete age kiddos- this is a one stop shop! I realize the rose/vanilla scent may seem feminine- but, this isn’t a florally fluff!! The throw is a fresh and clean scent- it has a dryer sheet vibe about it.. meaning one that you can smell after it’s  applied-like fresh clean laundry! (which is far better than body odor by a mile!)

Application is rather smooth but, does necessitate 2-3 swipes- If needed.. I also found, a touch up goes on just as smooth, if you’re heading out for the night… and can confidently last through to the next day! There’s no clumping or pilling of product noticed when in use.. Ha!
Using with multiple color fabrics has not been an issue with residue.. and that includes an all black soccer game uniform- this has yet to leave any staining on the fabric, bonus!

Being of pure Icelandic descent- to say we have sensitive skin is an understatement. This uses natural ingredients and has paid special attention to leaving out harsh chemicals- keeps it from adding irritants. So far, adverse reaction.

For a 3 bundle- it is a higher price point at $18.. but, you’re paying more for better quality return.  Overall, the Hardest working deodorant I found in a long time!
I hope this info helps your decision.. feel free to let me know!

reviews.title: Just ok all considering
reviews.body:
I got the color red. First of the smell of this is not bad. Unlike some hair coloring or hair tinting products that can smell pretty bad due to the chemicals this is actually not bad. They added some nice scents in it to cover up the chemicals they used for the color.

When you use it I decided to massage it into my wet hair, lather it up well and let it sit for like 3 to 5 minutes, mostly because I currently don't have my hair freshly colored and they say this will work best if you have your hair color and to keep the color more lively. That is why I decided to let it sit for a little instead of apply, massage in, lather and rinse which are the instructions. Btw, writing them a little bigger would have been nice since apparently my eye sight is going just a tad and reading this in the shower without glasses is not optimal. Anyways, the result was actually not bad. There was a hint of red in my hair and my hair did not have a chemical smell, but I did use a leave in conditioner afterwards so that could be the reason for that. It was nowhere near coloring your hair but I think if you keep using it you could intensify this, and I will try that. BUT I think it would be easier to just color it with temporary color instead and it would also be cheaper in my eyes instead of using this $35 shampoo! (most hair dye is like $5-$8 and even if you get semi permanent hair dye it will last at least 4 weeks!)

Lastly, when using it it was as bad almost as using real hair dye. My hands were deep red and it took quite a bit of rinsing and washing to get all this color of my hands. and of course I found out after I got out of the shower that my hairline had some colored shampoo that made a mess so that took a bit now to clean up since I let it sit for a few minutes. So make sure that you clean your hairline with water after you have the shampoo in there or you will have discolored skin. With that being said this can and will also stain your tiles, so make sure to rinse them right away.

So considering everything, it is not the most user friendly since most don't have a mirror in their bathroom to check they are not making a mess of themselves, does not provide a massive color boost which could be more easily achieved with just coloring instead when it starts to fade, which for most semi permanent dyes I found happens around 4 weeks, and considering the price of this at right now $35, I just give this a m3 stars. For that price I would expect more from this product.

reviews.title: This Stuff Actually WORKS Even On Very Fine Hair
reviews.body:
I had put too many blonde highlights in my hair- okay, WAY too many.  I had this conditioner handy so I was able to use it.  Toner was not doing it for me, let's see if this conditioner worked..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This conditioner is very expensive.  It comes in a very thin tall bottle which is only loaded with about 8 oz of product or so.  The smell is really nice, and it is fun to use from that perspective.  The conditioner is violet in tone but is not so dark that it dyes everything it touches.

HOW DO YOU USE THIS?
You put this on the hair after it is DAMP.  That means if in the shower, squeeze out all of the water and make it as close to damp as you can.  They say to put quite a bit on, but I only put on a very small amount like pea size perhaps.  I have baby fine hair which is easily weighed down with conditioner.  You work the conditioner through the hair and only leave it on for two minutes.  Then you rinse it out.

WHAT TYPE OF HAIR?
My baby fine hair is layered and is long- below shoulder blades.
DID IT WORK?
I could not capture the difference well in photos, but in person, WOW.  Not only did the conditioner turn my yellowing blonde hair cooler, but it did not weigh my hair down!  It made it glassy smooth and it really looked beautiful.  I can not use it often, but when I do, it looks amazing.

STAINS?
This did not stain my hands or tub at all.
HOW LONG BEFORE IT WASHES OUT?
I can usually get through two shampoos before it is completely gone, but that is okay, I like it that way. Sometimes I want it more yellow and other times I want it more cool and leaning toward platinum.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a nice conditioner that not only tones the hair from brassy blonde to cool blonde, but also does not weight down baby fine hair, this is the best I have ever used.  I would buy this again in a minute.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS.  I love this stuff.  It is fun to be able to use it to tone my hair, but not be stuck with it for long if I want to change the color palette I am wearing.

reviews.title: Exfoliating or Moisturizing?
reviews.body:
We have used SoftSoap products for years and we especially like the hand soap. However, we’re no strangers to body wash either and were interested in trying this body wash. It works well and smells great but I would hesitate to call it exfoliating unless it is used with a scrubber sponge or a loofa.

First off, the bottles came packaged with tape over the caps so they would not burst open in shipping. I was glad to see that – that could have been a horrible mess had even one of these opened enough to leak in the box.

It smells strongly of coconut and the fragrance transfers when you wash with it. After a good shower with this body wash I feel clean; that is, I didn’t notice it leaving a film behind like some soaps do.

This is marketed as an exfoliating soap but I didn’t feel anything in the soap that feels remotely abrasive enough like most exfoliating washes so I am not convinced of the claim that it will exfoliate on its own without scrubbing sponge or cloth. Where this body wash excels, however, is as a moisturizer. After a shower I noticed that my normally dry skin was softer and less dry. Maybe that’s what was meant by exfoliating?

It does work well as a hand soap – if you like coconut-scented hand soap. At least two of these bottles will end up being used for just washing hands.

This is decent body wash and hand soap, packaged well and pleasantly fragrant.

reviews.title: Great Root Coverage That Lasts, If You Don't Mind The Head Dive Into Garden Soil Look..
reviews.body:
Let's face it.  If you are looking at this, you are probably in need of emergency help for gray roots showing up amidst dyed brown hair.  Emergency situations will often tolerate more imperfections than if you were not in need of it so quickly.  Let's take a look at how this performs.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This root touch up pad is like makeup.  It is similar to eyeshadow, but it has other more creamy gripping ingredients in it.  It comes with a brush.  There is no fragrance added.  The color is medium brown.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
I had a situation where I needed this root cover up for someone in my household.  The roots were very gray and the hair was medium brown.  I have to say that this did cover the hair beautifully, but it also stuck to the scalp making it a bit frustrating.  This is fine for emergencies because gray or white roots showing behind brown hair are more noticeable than dark splotches on the scalp.  However, it still makes it look like you landed on your head in the garden.

DOES IT STAY?
The brown did stay on the hair very well for the entire day and night.  It also stayed on the scalp in patches which was a bit frustrating.  I tried to get it off the scalp and that was not easy at all.  It seemed to want to stay put.

DOES IT WASH OUT EASILY?
Yes, this did wash out easily.  That also means if you get caught in a downpour, you will probably lose coverage too.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Despite the fact that application seemed to emulate a head first dive into garden soil, the gray/white roots were fully covered and stayed that way for a day and evening until washed out.  It was hard to remove from the scalp.

MY RATING
THREE STARS because I do love having something that sticks to the hair, but the dirty scalp look was a bit frustrating.  I would say that this is more like 3 1/2 stars but I am giving it three.

Like all concealers, it has the potential to increase the appearance of fine lines if used without a moisturizer or foundation. I live in a warm climate and rarely do the base foundation thing, but I do use serums to help combat the look of aging. So far, this is the only concealer I have found that it is creamy and does not appear harsh or too matte once blended and dry. I also am thrilled that I received a light tone that matches my fair complexion. I have finally found a concealer that works! I highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Be More Beautiful This Year! Easy-to-Use and has a Great Brush!
reviews.body:
After seeing this brow pencil in the Better Homes and Gardens Magazine I decided to get one and try it out. I was interested in a new pencil since the one I've been using for years finally was running out.

This eyebrow pencil is easy-to-use and is the perfect size for defining eyebrows. You can pencil in missing hairs in places where your eyebrows have become a bit sparse. Then the miniature bottle brush (that is what it looks like) evens out the color and shapes the eyebrows perfectly. I am impressed! The brush almost seems intelligent in how it shapes the hair of your eyebrows into place.

Get the shade that looks closest to your hair color and it should be perfect. I got the medium brown and it matches my hair color perfectly. There is also no need to sharpen the pencil which is a bonus.

I feel like the way my eyebrows looked after I used this gave me a boost of confidence. You really will feel like a model who has a professional makeup artist! It makes my eyes look more open and pretty. If you are looking to enhance and frame your eyes, you can't go wrong with this. I'm glad I took the chance and it was easy to find here at amazon where I now buy most of my makeup.

~The Rebecca Review

reviews.title: Long Lasting Color and NO Itching/Burning!
reviews.body:
I've paid for boxed hair dyes that cost more than IL Salone and didn't work half as well.  I've used MANY different brands of dyes over the decades...IL Salone is hands down, the BEST I've ever used.

The directions are super easy to follow.  I was beyond thrilled and grateful that the dye sits well on hair and does not run or drip AT ALL! It stays exactly where applied until rinsed out. And rinsing out is easy as well-I had absolutely NO issues. The color shown on the box (I used extra light blonde) is the end result I wound up with. I did not experience any hair breakage. One of the best things about this hair dye...I experienced NO itching or burning! That is unheard of for me.  I have terribly sensitive skin. Until I tried Il Salone, I've ALWAYS experienced burning and itching with every other hair dye I've used. Some more than others but I had a reaction with every single one and in most cases. scratched my head like crazy the day after use while popping a Bendryl to try to calm the itching. That did NOT happen with this dye...AT ALL.  Also included with the dye and instructions: plastic gloves to use while applying, an after care conditioner and a hair mask to use 3 weeks after hair has been dyed. Both are very important, make sure to use them.

The color stays fresh and vibrant for a long time. I can actually use this less often that my previous brand.

This is a salon quality hair dye you can use in the comfort of your own home. I truly thought the price would be higher for as well as it works.  I've officially switched from my old brand of dye to Il Salone. (In fact, I enrolled in Amazon's 'subscribe and save' for monthly delivery!)  If you're coloring your hair yourself, I HIGHLY recommend IL Salone hair dye!

reviews.title: Easy to use and gentle on your hair.
reviews.body: My wife tried this hair coloring kit. The color is chocolate blonde, but it is really not blonde, it is more of a light brown color, but this is exactly what she was looking for. It’s so easy to use like any other hair dye kit, and yet it is gentle on your hair as well.

reviews.title: Worked Well, Leaving Hair In Good Condition
reviews.body:
I used this on a person whose hair I have done for some time now.  They were prematurely gray so dyeing was a way of life.  Finding a good brown which does not pull red is not easy for this person.

HOW THIS COMES
This is similar than most hair dye kits.  It is easy to mix and apply.

HOW I USED
I mixed this in a tray with a professional brush and applied that way instead of the bottle.

PROCESS
This was a great dye.  The smell was not overwhelming, and there was not any burning.  The person whose hair I did liked that it did not seem to cause the hair to become dry and parched when using.

HAIR USED ON
This was used on significantly gray hair with some dark brown hair mixed in about 50% of each or so.

RESULTS
The results were a beautiful deep brown.  At first it looked like this was going to pull some reddish tones, but it ended up being just a nice dark brown.

HAIR CONDITION
This did not leave the hair feeling stripped or dry when done.  So far the color has stayed in fairly well.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This seemed to be a nice basic dark brown hair dye.  It did not pull severely red, and it dyed well on mostly gray hair.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS.  This was pretty decent hair dye, I will update if I have anything to add as time goes by regarding fading and hair condition.

PHOTO
I hope to get a photo up if I can.  Internet issues have made it difficult to post photos at times.

reviews.title: Did help with brassiness
reviews.body:
I'll admit, I may not be a perfect use case for Il Salone Milano Plex Rebuilder's Yellow Remover. I've dyed grey ombre hair, or at least grey ombre hair in progress. My hair has been lots of colors in the past few years, permanent and semi-permanent, and it's been a process to go with the latest transition (especially when the teal color turned out to be NOT semi-permanent and I'm trying not to over-bleach). I decided to give this kit a try to deal with some brassiness in spots where I've platinum grey and darker 'grey' areas.
I left it on for twenty minutes, as instructed, and didn't apply it directly to the roots. It didn't appear to affect the darker/black sections of my hair, which I didn't expect, really. It did help to tone down some of the brassiness I had, which is good. Perhaps not as much if I was a light blonde or platinum all over, but it did help. I used the one conditioning packet and my hair feels very soft (the conditioner smells wonderful). I don't think I'd want to use this too often, but it wasn't unduly harsh and had some effect.

However, it works well on both liquid and powder foundation. Due to the closeness of the very soft bristles, liquid foundation spreads evenly. What I really like this for, however, is to use the pointed end with powder blush and work from the jawbone down toward the face to highlight the cheeks with a darker shade of blush. The handle makes this easy to control during application.

In summary, this is a niche brush that is also a conversation piece. It is definitely not going to be for everyone but I personally like the quirkiness and functionality of this little treasure.  The current price of $5.49 is on the high side of competitively priced.

reviews.title: Not The Right Conditioner For Me (but it smells GREAT!)
reviews.body: As my hair air-dried following my first use of Cuvee conditioner, I thought perhaps I hadn't rinsed it out entirely.  It looked and felt dried out and kind of hard. I had some tangles as well though they were easy and painless to comb through.  When it did dry  completely, it wasn't any better.  It was visibly dry and crunchy.  My natural waves weren't nice and smooth, they kind of looked as though I had a mild case of static electricity taking place. I kept my hair in a ponytail and gave it another shot the next night.  Unfortunately, and after spending extra time rinsing my hair to be safe, I wound up with the same result as the previously night.  I really wish this conditioner had worked better with  my hair. I really like the consistency-it reminds of me of canned whipped cake frosting!  Its nice and lightweight and 'airy'  and boy, does it ever smell GOOD!  I could still smell it in my hair the following day and that doesn't happen often for me. Its rare that I can still smell a conditioner the following day as I could with Cuvee.  I also found it easy to work through my hair when I applied it and didn't have to use much to sufficiently cover my shoulder length, thick hair.  I did have some better luck with Cuvee's texture spray and Blowout Bombe (I will review both). For whatever reason, Cuvee's conditioner just did not work well on my hair and I have no plans to purchase it in the future.

Sadly I didn’t feel like it put the moisture back in my hair nor did my hair feel particularly soft or smooth. All in all I am not too impressed with this product.
