reviews.title: I like ours
reviews.body:
The bed is good for the prices and you get what you pay for, but I think I should mention the cons. One: I've had this for about Two months and the top fabric got a puncture hole in it from the dogs walking on it in under three days. Two: the shipping was an almost nightmare. My shipping was delayed by a day, no big deal, but the bed doesn't ship compressed (like I hoped it would) and my box would have been in shambles if not for an excessive amount of tape. That's not really the suppliers fault, but figuring a way to compress it so it can fluff up at a home would make a huge difference. Third: tape. It came covered in plastic, which I appreciate, but the plastic was tapped to the bed too... I actually thought that the tape had lifted some of the material off the bed, but it just left an almost hard to get off residue from the adhesive. I'm sure that all of this goes back to you getting what you pay for. For $40 for a bed this large compared to $70- $80 these aren't completely huge issues that'll keep my dogs from using it.

Miracle is that my brindle dog doesn't like laying down with the other dogs. Not even in my queen sized bed when it's just them and myself. My boy is so stubborn that he'll prefer sleeping on the hard floor under the bed first (reason I bought this I felt bad). It's comfortable too. I've sat on the bed and it didn't hold up to a fully grown adult, obviously, but it tried. I first made my little cousin lay on it to test it out and she instantly wanted one for herself to use. My cousin is under 90 pounds and she said she couldn't feel the floor and that was a big concern, because my dogs aren't going to tell me that. I haven't noticed the material not fully snapping back in the bed portion because I do like to lay down with my dogs. The arms could be more durable, but for the price I'm not complaining too much about that.

My luck could have been bad with the shipping and I have more than two dogs so I might tempt fate again to see if the shipping was just a fluke, because we enjoy having the bed at our home. All around getting what you pay for this was a great steal.

Also my dogs make the bed look small, it's not, I'm 6'2" and not small. I can comfortably sit cross legged on this with enough room to sit my phone or a remote next to me or maybe a good sized dog toy. Yes, I had to make them think it was a people seat so they'd use the new bed. They're dirty shameless spot stealers.

reviews.title: Returned immediately

Like any dog bed I purchase for my German Shepherds, having a thick inner foam is extremely important to me for supporting my boys hips and joints. When the bed arrived I placed it on the hard wood floor and sat on it. I immediately sunk to the floor and felt the hard floor under me. I weigh 132.
I then pushed on it with my hand and could easily feel the floor because the foam inside is not dense enough. Very poor quality.  My boys weigh 97 and 128 pounds. Honestly Costco beds have been the best ones so far and I guess we will keep buying those. I really liked the concept of the head rest for my pups, but this bed isn’t made well at all. Yes, your dog will like a new dog bed and eagerly want to lay on it, but as a fur parent you know what’s best for them. This bed won’t offer the support needed for large breed hips and joints.

reviews.title: Great for small dog
reviews.body:
We have an area with this pen for my miniature daschshund. It's not that we don't trust her to be loose in the house at night, but we know she'd be scratching at our bedroom door all night and we prefer not to sleep with the animals. It's a routine for her to go into her pen where her bed, food, and water are every night and it works very well for us. She has a tiny bladder so a litter box with a pee pad in it helps her out in case of bathroom emergency (honestly sometimes I think she's just too lazy to wake us up to let her out at night when it's cold).
Right now it's helpful because she hurt her back doing something silly like leaping off the couch to chase a cat. She's under strict bed rest for a while and this pen is so useful for that! This way she won't be shut in a cage with just her bed--especially because the medication she on during recovery causes her to drink and pee a lot (the towel is acting like a small step for her to not have to hop into her bed).
We flipped the pen upside-down so that she doesn't have to hop over the bottom door frame.

reviews.title: Really great for indoor or outdoor rabbit exercise area
reviews.body: I now have 5 of these pens that I use for our four rabbits for outdoor exercise.  Three are hooked together for a nice roomy 10' x 14' play area for two of the bunnies.  The other two pens are set up individually for our two buns that aren't a bonded pair yet so they can be side by side until they are ready to be together. I've had the first one for over two years and it is still in great shape, with only slight rusting of the clips that hold the panels together.  Not a big deal.  I'm really happy with these pens. They are great quality, very portable, easy to fold and store when not in use, and hold up well outside.  I leave mine out all year round and they have held up very well.  I like that the 24" height is just right for containing the rabbits but easy enough for me to step over when I want to access their play area.

reviews.title: Great life vest for the dog in your life. A must have for any boat owner!

I am assuming (as I can't technically get in her mind, lol) that her fear has something to do with the unfamiliarity of the water and of her lack of swimming in her day to day life. I use this vest every time we go out in the boat. With it on, I know that she is protected in the event we had to vacate the boat (we technically use the boat in the intercoastal waterway here in south florida. I have carried her into the water with me when I wade in waist deep water to let her try it out and I honestly think she enjoys the added protection and it gives her some self confidence in the water. I highly recommend this vest for your loved animals for when you take them out on the ocean/lake/sea (like you would with your own children).

reviews.title: Fit advice for small athletic dogs
reviews.body:
My chihuahua/terrier mix is 12 lbs, 16.5 inches in girth, and 12 inches from neck to tail.  He has the barrel chest and trim athletic body of a terrier.  The sizing guide puts him square in the middle of an XS so I bought that.  I put it on him and it was too small.  The velcro on the underbelly barely met and while I could get the buckles and straps fit for him, it was too tight behind his neck.  So I kept the XS for another dog and got him a S.  That fits perfectly.

I love that this has neck floatation.  So many other life jackets have reviewers saying that their dog floats butt high and face lower in the water.  Not good!  This one has lots of floatation, seems like he'll float level in it, and is really sturdy and snug when I pick him up by the handle (this doesn't seem uncomfortable for him either).  But, I haven't gotten him in the water in it yet.

reviews.title: Thick, firm as described
reviews.body:
This Barkbox mat is a nice, thick, firm dog mat that I placed in the family room.  Orthopedic mats can be quite expensive.  I think that this Barkbox mat is a good price, and the quality seems very good.  My elderly sheltie likes it but tends to prefer a smaller, much-less expensive (aka "cheap") orthopedic mat that is kept in the kitchen.  I think that she prefers the location of the smaller kitchen mat, which is not a well-known brand, because it is tucked into a small, cozy place.

I have a younger sheltie with a 42" crate.  I found that this size Barkbox mat is just a bit wider than the crate but can be stuffed into the crate and flattened.  It is a fabulous crate mat.  Since the elderly sheltie seems to prefer the smaller, less-expensive orthopedic mat in the kitchen, I may use this mat as a crate mat for the younger dog. reviews.title: Dangerous bc metal not properly coated! Rough edges!
reviews.body: Where to begin?  I’ve been trying to get the 20 pics of these eyesores to upload since I received them, but they won’t. I ordered them bc one of my service dogs had emergency surgery & both pups were exposed to weed killer my LL put down, but I was unaware of & both pups became ill.  I knew when they arrived that I should have immediately returned them bc both boxes had the look about them that they were someone else’s previous returns.  The bad tape jobs on the boxes are generally a pretty good indicator imo. Both kennels had been placed together in one larger box for shipping so they should neither of them have had such a horrific tape job applied to them. I’ve purchased Midwest kennels for over 35 years & I’ve never purchased them with this kind of tape job in my life.  These were not “factory sealed”.  These hasd obviously been opened & returned. Worse- it looked as tho someone kept the new kennel & returned their old one bc you can literally see where all the powder coating is missing on these kennels which happens over time from use & friction.  One piece in particular has no coating on it whatsoever as can be seen in the photos that won’t load. Lol.  I thought I was buying direct from the manufacturer this time as I’ve moved away from buying from third party sellers due to receiving items like these kennels.  What’s annoying is I desperately needed this for a dog post surgery & im left with an un-safe kennel.  The metal is jagged throughout. I’ve cut my own hands numerous times bc the costing is missing & the metal is bare & rough.  Either the quality of Midwest has taken a nosedive in the 4 yrs since I last purchased a kennel or someone sent me used items.  I cannot recommend this item bc it is dangerous to ur pups eyes, nose, skin, paws, fur, etc.  jagged edges have no business near animal nor human bodies.

Comes with a partition so it can grow with your puppy (for crate training a younger puppy, you would use the partition to create a "smaller" space, so the dog won't think it can just eliminate in one corner of the full-size crate and sleep in the other). Altogether, we are very pleased.

reviews.title: June 2017 recall for contamination. Made in China. Avoid.
reviews.body:
Nope. There are two reasons why I refuse to even open this bag and would absolutely never ever consider giving these to my dogs. First - this is made in China. I believe we are all aware of the dangers of China sourced ingredients in dog treats.

Second is the fact that this company had a recall in June 2017 for several of it's brands of rawhide dog treats. The recall is for products made with "rawhide" for contamination with quaternary ammonium compounds. This can cause diarrhea, vomiting and loss of appetite. Further more, this is a cleaning compound not approved for use in the United States for rawhide production. (Per the FDA site) This is just unacceptable and I will steer clear of all the brands from this company.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT LEASH SET with COLLAPSIBLE WATER BOWL
reviews.body:
We breed and own Goldendoodles and have had many dogs for years.  Owning multiple dogs means managing walking multiple dogs and this leash set has what you need to easily walk and control two dogs at once.

This is an excellent leash set by COOYOO.  The leashes are constructed of heavy duty, durable nylon material.  The handles are backed with foam making them comfortable to hold and allowing for better control.  The leashes conclude in a heavy duty coated metal clips that swivel 360 degrees which helps keep the leash from getting twisted and tangled.

In addition to the excellent leashes, this set comes complete with a collapsible water bowl that includes a D-clip.  It can be attached to one of the leashes and used whenever your dogs are thirsty.

This is an excellent leash set for medium to large dogs.  Due to the weight of the leashes it would not be recommend for small dogs.

This is a well made product that I definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Be sure to get the right size!
reviews.body: My 7 month old puppy had surgery last week and prior to his appointment I found this and figured I'd give it a go. I've had plenty of past experiences with the plastic cone collars that the vet supplies and sends your dog home with after a surgery. Those things, while an effective licking deterrent, always end up scraping stairs, marking walls, getting caught on furniture and nicking you in the ankles and calves. No fun! This inflatable collar arrived a few days before our scheduled trip to the vet so I had some time to play with it and give it a test run. It's been awhile since I last blew up a balloon, but I didn't think I was *that* out of shape! It took me a good 20 minutes to get the entire ring filled with enough air to make it firm. I love how the outer cover is removable and washable.. but in order to remove it, you have to deflate the ring.. something I cannot figure out for the life of me. After looking over the sizing chart, I settled on the large size as my puppy's neck is right at the bottom end of the large size range. Wrong move. It is very loose on him, even when cinched up as tight as it will go. Oh well, he is using his plastic collar from the vet. Unfortunate for my walls and ankles, but at least his incisions are protected. I plan to keep this inflatable collar for future post-surgical needs, but only if I can figure out how to deflate the blasted thing!

reviews.title: Great item for pet owners to have on hand
reviews.body:
Thankfully, we have never needed to use a collar like this for one of our cats. The last time they had a head collar was for their neutering surgery.

But, I do like to be prepared for various scenarios. There are times when your pet could get a big scratch, a bug bite or some other problem for which you might want to put an ointment or cream on them. You don't want them to be able to lick or chew a hot spot or sore. This collar is great for that.

It is inflatable in the manner of a beach ball...pinch the valve and blow. The collar is soft, and has adjustable hook-n-loop closures, making a custom fit easy. This would work for cats or small dogs.

Overall, I'd endorse keeping one of these in with emergency pet supplies or prepping supplies. This is a very nice head collar.

reviews.title: So Much Better That a Cone!

This is so much better than having your dog wear a cone.  Every time our dogs have had to wear cones they end up running into the walls and furniture due to not being able to navigate the size of the cone.  This blow up ring accomplishes the same thing without extending way out in front.

What I found with this product is while our Poodle’s neck measured 12.5” so I went with a Large Ring - due to our Moyen Poodle having a skinny shaped head, after using this ring for a while I wished I would have gone with a Medium Ring.

This is an outstanding product that works great and is far more comfortable fit your pet versus the standard cone.

reviews.title: Sophie just LOVES this food but the dehydrated quality has an ICK factor to me and my friend
reviews.body:
I got this for my friend's dogs and decided to just give it to Sophie. The food is powdered because it is dehydrated. It is unpalatable looking to me and my friend and is even more ICKY once it is rehydrated with water. We rehydrated about one quarter cup with room temperature water and let it sit for a few seconds. Once it was hydrated we gave it to Sophie who just loved it. She kept going back to lick up every last morsel. However, my friend and I looked at the food and had to suppress a dry heave because it has the look of upchuck.

The first 11 ingredients are dehydrated turkey, organic oats, dehydrated potatoes, organic flaxseed, dehydrated carrots, dehydrated cabbage, dried apples, dehydrated honey, dehydrated organic kelp, dried garlic, minerals, etc.

As long as the human can stand rehydrating this food, then I guess it is fine. I personally do not care for it but Sophie would disagree as she just licked it all up.

Note that the current price of $34.29 for this box is outrageous to me.

PS Amazon is rotating all pictures for the last several months. Therefore, if the pictures are upside down, I apologize for that.

reviews.title: we love it for use in treat toys and as the occasional meal topper
reviews.body:
We use a lot of Honest Kitchen products for our furry menagerie. We have two young labs (5& 3), and three cats (8, 18, &18). From powder & liquid broths, milks, stews, pates, meal boosters (similar to a baby food), treats, and dehydrated food (kibble style and I thought this exact product, but I can't find it in my purchase history). We don't use any of it as their sole source of nutrition, and all of my reviews reflect that. We happen to use another brand of kibble that we have been happy with, but since we TOP OFF their food with fresh food and food by Honest Kitchen, I feel like everyone is getting a good variety. This is another good one.

As always, depends on your dog.

The dehydrated food is great for us for using in our WestPaw Toppl https://smile.amazon.com/gp/product/B00N54EGD0/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_search_asin_title?ie=UTF8&psc=1

We make up a batch (add water, let sit), smoosh it inside the Topple, add a few other goodies, and then freeze it. I have use it in Kongs, but my two aren't big fans of the Kong. The Topple is easier.

So if you, like me, are looking for healthy food items to use in treat puzzles, or to make their regular kibble a little more interesting, this might work out for you.

INGREDIENTS:
All ingredients dehydrated: Turkey, organic oats, potatoes, organic flaxseed, carrots, cabbage, organic kelp, apples, honey, garlic, tricalcium phosphate, choline chloride, zinc amino acid chelate, vitamin D3 supplement, vitamin E supplement, potassium iodide, potassium chloride, iron amino acid chelate, copper amino acid chelate, sodium selenite, thiamine mononitrate. All ingredients are processed in the USA in a human grade food processing facility. They are non genetically modified and free of any chemicals & preservatives. All meat is hormone and antibiotic free.

If this is brand new to your dog, then add a little into their regular food, and gradually increase the new and reduce the old.

reviews.title: being enjoyed by my 17 year old elderly "kittens"
reviews.body:
My 17 year old elderly kittens seem to like it. No they are not actually kittens, but I am not going to tell them that!

 They may change their mind about liking this food in a couple of days, but for now they are gobbling it up. I know it isn't great on their digestive system to change up their food, but I give my dear elderlies whatever they want, when they want it, as much as they want. And since they are picky and have me trained well, I just jump when they call.

I am just trying to keep some weight on their too slender frames. I had looked into buying senior food, but that seems to be all about reducing calories- which I don't want! Further digging around mentioned giving kitten food- more nutrients, calories. So when I can, I look for kitten food they will like, or an all life stages food that is suitable for kittens. I just try to avoid the calorie reduction foods.

This is variety box of pate and food bits with gravy. My two like the slightly wetter pate that this offers over adult. I usually add water, and will continue to do so, but this at least starts off fairly moist. They really like the cans that have the little bits of food with gravy the most- that the will clean the plate. Both are good, but latter is their preference. Overall, if they like it, I like it.

reviews.title: Kitten Approved!
reviews.body:
We were adopted by a stray kitten.  While we  were not looking for another pet he found us and my son and our dogs fell in love.  I guess I’ll admit I’m pretty fond of him as well - he follows me everywhere I go when I’m outside...

I decided to get him this food and he loves it. Somehow he can hear the crack of the can wherever he is and he comes running.

The main ingredients are chicken or fish depending on the flavor and it is fortified with DHA and vitamins.  There is a minimum crude protein content of 12-13% depending on the flavor.

This is a high quality wet food that is great to either use as a primary food - 1 can per 11-12 pounds your cat weighs, split into 3 meals, or as a supplement to their dry food.

Our kitten loves this food so we both recommend it.

⭐️As with all Drew’s Reviews, if I discover something new about this product - good or bad - I will UPDATE my review.  I believe in creating detailed, complete reviews because, like you, I depend on them when I am shopping.  If you found my review HELPFUL - please click ⬇️ below!⭐️

With my last kitten I had some trouble makers and of course they disagreed on what they want to eat so I had them try this one. Some of them loved it while some of them did not. That is ok since in my experience there are always kittens that love some food and others do not. That is why I have always different types of wet food in my house because kittens can be picky. Once they get older it gets easier and they become less picky but when you wean them it is a lot more difficult. I will definitely keep this one in my house since I now know kittens approve of it and will eat this one as well. reviews.title: TWENTY STARS for HELPING my SHY KITTY to enjoy LIFE
reviews.body: Beyond excellent!!!! Ten stars. I have a shy kitty that has every cat nip toy on the market. I have tried so hard to get her to move for ten years. Toys meant to entice, would cause her to hide. I gave up. I watched an episode of the Cat Whisperer and decided to not give up on my kitty. I wanted her to enjoy being a cat instead of running away from toys. I read reviews on endless items and ran across this one. I felt the high number of reviews could not possibly be fake and for a few dollars....why not give a try.  I started for a few minutes and rubbed the toy all around her face, including the wand. When I wiggled the string, she ran. I wiggled it inside of her hiding spot and her foot would stick out to grab it, she couldn't resist. Every day I tried to play with her a little longer. I would play with her after a few weeks whenever she was walking around and eventually she started not hiding. I sprayed the Charmer down with PET ORGANIC NO-STRESS...only product that has worked. WEEKS LATER, she jumps and runs all over. I am careful not to get to crazy and watch to see what movement makes her comfortable. Fearful cats could associate wiggling with snakes so I also keep it in mind. PLUS< the toy is MADE IN USA, no TOXIC CHEMICALS to kill your animal off from CHINA. TWENTY STARS for thinking outside of the box.

reviews.title: Great Product!
reviews.body: I have one cat box (Scoopfree electric one) for two cats. It's great! Since I don't change the litter until after 2 weeks, sometimes the odor is off putting. I sprinkle this deodorizer when needed and it keeps the odors at bay, which does extend the life of the crystal litter. Although it's not a big container, the deodorizer goes a long way. One lasts me about a month which is what I expect. Besides the fact that it does cut down on the odors, the best thing is that it doesn't mask it with flowery or unpleasant fragrances. There is no smell at all! I've tried baking soda, etc. and this beats all of them. Expensive but worth it!

reviews.title: Works but not great
reviews.body: I keep renting this but I'm not sure it works as well as I'd hoped. The smell is like a VERY faint ozone scent so not unpleasant and it does seem to eliminate cat box odors in the moment. It isn't long lasting. Or maybe I'm not using enough? I use unscented litter though since cats have a better sense of smell and don't enjoy perfume type smells as much as I do and the litterbox is necessary for my indoor-only cats so I don't want them to be uncomfortable. I'll keep buying this because it doesn't bother my two furry family members and it does work, just not great.

reviews.title: Orijen: A Life-Saving Cat Food
reviews.body: My cat LOVES this food! The smell is extremely enticing and the taste is even better. He has no idea it is diet food. He even prefers Orijen over his old foods- Royal Canin GI Fiber Response and wet foods (Ziwi Peak flavors Rabbit and Lamb & Mackarel and Lamb flavors). The high protein and low carbohydrate diet are recommend for cats to live a long and healthy life. I researched which food to feed my kitty extensively before choosing Orijen because he was recently diagnosed with cancer and it is best to feed cat's a high protein, low carbohydrate diet in order to fight this disease because most cat foods on the market have more than 15% carbohydrate ratio, which actually feeds that cancer and does not aid in extending the kitty's life. Also, older, male cats have a tendency to develop hypothyroidism and diabetes due to a high carbohydrate diet, so Orijen's Fit and Trim food is an excellent choice for anyone looking for a cat food to prevent and reduce obesity, which contributes to both of those diseases in kitties and can be very difficult to treat from experience. Although Orijen is pricey, it is worth the cost when treating cancer, diabetes, and hypothyroidism can cost upwards into the thousands.

reviews.title: Orijen Cat and Kitten

While researching I had questions and they were very timely and forthcoming with answers.

reviews.title: My dog loves these dog treats!
reviews.body: My dog absolutely loved these, and honestly saying that is a lot. She typically is picky and snubs her nose at most things (with the exception of some human foods). When I first got these I was skeptical, but surprisingly she loved these and begged for more. If there is any complaint (and there is none really) it's that these are all pieces of different sizes and they do crumble easily. I wish they were in a little larger size so I don't have to feed her some pieces which are almost like crumbs. Not sure if it comes this way or whether it's just the way this one package came to me. I like pieces I can hand to her which she can take one at a time. Anyway, outside of that, I (and my Roxie) loves these.

Only bad thing is that 3 ounces does not last long with two Shepherd mixes, but they are adored while they last.

reviews.title: Got at my work
reviews.body:
Been eye balling these lately! I chose the lamb hearts, because I don't feed beef or chicken to my dogs. I chose to hydrate the treat with water after seeing someone else's beef treats where mostly fat. There's not a lot of fat on the lamb hearts! It seems pretty lean. There is parts that are pretty firm so I'm thinking some gristle, but I'd have to research to see if that's possible. Maybe a tendon? It felt firm, but not like the firmness from if we'd chew gristle on accident (no I didn't taste it). So maybe there is caution with smaller breeds?

I soaked a broken chunk in water for about 10 minutes and it wasn't too shabby. My 65 pound pit mix really liked it and so did his two house mates.  Personally I'd buy it again. These are supposed to be high reward treats, bag calories in total at 3,600, and I feel like this is a treat my dog would really work for. Like teaching an old dog new tricks reality.

Beef and chicken products tend to be lower in quality in general if anyone wants to order or buy in store. 4 star review, because of full sized treats maybe not being safe for smaller breeds. I thought of that in advance and even broke it up for my bigger dogs. Plus it's high calorie and heart is nutrient dense so I don't see dogs needing large chunks.

For one ingredient dog treats? I'd buy it again.

reviews.title: Great Product!
reviews.body:
This crate cover was a life saver for two different reasons. Firstly I had a dog that would only go in their crate if it was covered. I used blankets to cover it previously but the dog would pull them through and chew them overnight. Then I found this cover! Dog was happy going into the crate as it was covered and also they could not pull it through and chew. Win, win situation!

Second cover I used for a dog that I used to look after for a friend and the dog would spray pee out through the side of the crate. I used this cover thinking that at least if he did do that  with the cover on then it wouldn't be spraying the wall as the cover would stop it. Well the cover did stop it when the dog sprayed in the crate but what me and my friend were most astonished by was that he never tried it again after the pee splashed back off the cover the one time he tried it. Subsequently he has never tried it again! Again a win, win situation.

reviews.title: WHY I changed from FIVE stars to ONE...and may change back
reviews.body:
WHAT I USED TO FEEL about this brand for YEARS and MAYBE still do, is it's FIVE stars.  BUT with the new info out there re grain free, well, not sure.

PROS:
Quality of ingredients:  My dog has been on lamb dry food since I got him.  He has a slightly sensitive tummy and lamb works best.  I switched to Taste of the Wild Lamb about seven years ago, my dog is now over nine years old and has always done well on it.  I liked they even used filtered water.
Digestibility:  Like I mentioned, my dog has a slightly sensitive digestive system and this has been GREAT for him.
Health:  Well my dog is nine years and always gotten good vet checks, just was into the vet for yearly check about a month ago and is in good shape esp for nine.
Price:  I thought well worth the extra price of some considered lower grade foods.

CON:  OK, like many of you, I have read about the POSSIBLE link to heart disease and grain free foods or some of the ingredients or LACK of certain ingredients in grain free foods.  Seems they're not exactly sure yet.  BUT to be on the SAFE side, on the advice of my vet, I researched LAMB foods with rice, as he really does best on lamb.  AFTER MUCH searching (and trying Science Diet Lamb and Rice small kibble, which my dog took one bit and spit out) I now have him on DIAMOND NATURALS LAMB AND RICE.  I transitioned him using the left over Taste of the Wild, mixing about half and half, to not upset his digestion.  He is doing well on the Diamond Naturals.  I MAY OR MAY NOT have needed to switch him, but I, like all dog owners, love my dog and didn't want to chance it til scientists discover what the heck is going on.

reviews.title: Works Great in the Breeze System!
reviews.body: I made the switch from traditional cat litter boxes to the Tidy Cat Breeze System over a year ago and have been very pleased. These pads work perfectly in the tray. I think they are actually more absorbent than the original ones that came with the set. These are lemon scented, but not very strong. I have 2 Breeze systems for my 1 cat. I usually have to replace the pads about once a week with rotating it once since my cat tends to urinate in the same corner of the box every time. I will definitely reorder these in the future.

reviews.title: These are for a specific litter box system and are pretty much useless otherwise
reviews.body:
When I ordered these for review, I thought these were fitted pads for underneath the litter in a litter box. There was no description other than the title and I got the Amazon dog when trying to find out more information.

However, these are for use with a litter box system [[ASIN:B001411SK0  such as this]] where the urine will flow through to the pad and the pad can be changed. I have three cats and I require LARGE litter pans. I do not have such a system and those systems tend to be small anyway.

As a result, I could not use these in the litter pan because the cats would just paw it up and it would get mixed in with the litter. I tried to re-purpose these outside the litter pan, but they are too small for that also as can be seen from the second photo.

In summary, I have no doubt that these will work in a litter system as long as the padded part needed is no longer than 9.5" x 15" with a full pad size (counting the non-padded border) of 11.5" x 16.5". The pad is lightly scented and absorbent. Just be aware of the litter system needed before purchasing.

reviews.title: Just as good as the Breeze--
reviews.body:
I decided to try these because while I love the Breeze system, I was balking a bit at the cost (esp since one bag of litter wasn't deep enough).  I started off using one pad a week (both with Breeze and this), but as kitten grew, so did the amount of urine he produces :P  so I change the pad twice a week (but also did with the Breeze).  The Amazon pad is unscented (a plus for me over the Breeze, their "unscented" still had a strong scent to me) and they haven't leaked.  As a side note for those using Breeze, I bought a bag of wood stove pellets and mix them in with the Breeze pellets--this gives a lot more bulk (which my kitten appreciates--he hates not being able to cover stuff), while the Breeze pellets are still plentiful enough to dehydrate and cut the smell.  The wood DOES degrade when it gets wet, so I get some "shavings" on top of the pee pad--another reason I change it twice a week, to make sure that doesn't build up too much.  The two pellets together seem to work really well for me at a more affordable price.

For those wondering, Breeze pads are over $2 each (normally, even on Amazon)-- these run (at the most expensive, unscented, box of 20 for $14.14) .70 each...so even if you use twice as many, it's still cheaper!

If you want to give braided a try, I recommend this brand for its quality. And the price is certainly reasonable.

reviews.title: Great Glove For Beginners Works Great - Our Daughter Loves It
reviews.body:
My daughter is a new baseball player.  She really wanted a glove that she could use that was her own and not borrowed.  Although she did not play a fielding position a whole lot, she still found it useful.  I was more of a real leather fan of gloves, but this one is a nice glove, especially for anyone starting out in baseball.

WHAT IS THIS GLOVE LIKE?
This glove is not genuine leather.  It is soft grippy faux leather that has a nice curvy fit to it.  The inside has a thumb loop in it which helps to control the glove when using it.  The pocket is soft, yet tough and woven stripes of faux leather that is black in color.  The inside has faux fur strip on the back of the hand, and the inside is slick enough to allow the glove to be put on and taken off quickly without being too slick.  There is an adjustable tab to help tighten the thumb area, if necessary.

HOW DID THIS GLOVE PERFORM?
My daughter is thrilled with this glove.  She said that even when she was playing catcher it was a great glove.  She had good control, was able to grab the ball with ease and accuracy.  She loves the thumb loop inside.

CON
More velcro to adjust the thumb loop would be nice

WHAT SIZE HAND?
My daughter has a medium size ladies hand with shorter fingers than most women.  I have a medium to large sized hand with longer fingers. This glove fits both of our hands nicely.  Our son has a medium to large man's hand and it does not fit his hand.  I would say that this is for a small man's hand, larger youth hand, or a medium to large women's size hand.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although she wishes that the adjustment for the thumb was a bit longer velcro, this glove has been a wonderful glove for our daughter as she begins to play baseball.  It fits very well, is comfortable for longer periods of time, yet comes off easily if necessary.  It worked well for all of her positions played including catcher.  This glove remained pliable and worked very well allowing for accuracy and gripping action.

FIVE stars for this glove.  It is a hit in this family (for those who can wear it)

First, these are tennis balls. They are not indestructible. Second, I save them by using them only indoors. I have another pair I use for outdoor and change them just as I walk out the door. This works great.
Yes, these will eventually wear down to the rubber and eventually through the rubber. Friction does that. You can save them by using a different pair for indoor and outdoor. The outdoor will wear down first. They are inexpensive so I buy a few and have them handy.

reviews.title: so our need for water was not as great as it would be on a hot day in ...
reviews.body:
I purchased four of these vapur water bottles in different colors for a family trip to DisneyWorld. The goal was for each family member to carry their own water (and other basic items) for a full day at the parks. We were there in January, so our need for water was not as great as it would be on a hot day in August. We basically used one entire bottle each per day, plus 1-2 purchased drinks and only on one day, a refill of the vapur at a water fountain. On an average day, the full bottle was enough without a refill. We bought a case of bottled water at an Orlando supermarket for $6 and kept it in our hotel room. Each morning, we filled the vapur bottles. This saved some money and saved us time that might have been spent waiting in line to buy water.

The vapur bottles don't look very sturdy, but we used them for a solid week and didn't have a single spill, tear, or leak. The caps stayed shut even though they were jostled around in backpacks for hours on end. The carabiner clip can be used to wear the bottle, but we just threw ours in our small backpacks. When the bottles are empty, they can be rolled up and tucked into the clip, taking up less space.

There was no problem taking the empty bottles through airport security.

I am very happy with this item and feel it was a smart purchase.

reviews.title: Lightweight Solution To Plaster Water Bottles
reviews.body: I've becomes really conscious about my plastic use and I never really like bottled water anyway.  So, when I received the Vapur Solid BPA Free Durable Foldable Flexible Water Bottle with Carabiner I was excited and sad that I didn't have this sooner.  I'm excited to have something that I can just fold up into my purse or backpack and then fill at a water fountain when I need and then fold it back up.  As a mother, I got tired of the diaper bag real quick.  I wish I had this when my 7 year old was in a stroller because this would have been ideal!  I like how there is a carabiner so I can attached onto things either my backpack or if you have a stroller or bike.  It's not going to keep water cold, but if you get tired to carrying bottles of water, especially plastic bottles, this is definitely a solution.

reviews.title: Some pros, some cons
reviews.body:
First the pros:
*The water inside it tastes like nothing which is exactly how you want water to taste.
*It's very clever and portable.
*The lid fits very securely to prevent leaks from the top.

And then the cons:
*You can't put regular ice in it (though you can freeze the whole thing ahead of a hike or whatever).
*It's very difficult to fill without spilling.
*The seams are not very secure making me fear leaks are in the not too distant future.

I'm really on the fence about this bottle.  The idea is super cool and it has a lot of potential.  The execution is just not that great, however.  I'll put it in my emergency bag because, really, that's the only scenario I can imagine actually wanting to use it in.

reviews.title: Consider the length over the stretch
reviews.body:
First of all, i bought this pants not entirely for yoga and thus i picked the one with pockets.  I needed a pair of leggings with fleece that i can walk my dog during winter (in California!!).  Don't judge me...but i am terrified of the cold.  I bought the pants in two sizes, two colors; all with pockets.

FIT:
"M" and "S" fits me perfectly because the material is super stretchy and extremely comfortable.  I'm 5'6 and 133lbs.  "M" has the length that would wrap around the heel nicely and it doesn't feel bulky.  I ended up taking the "S" simply because it was in black and i didn't want to take the trouble of returning.  But on the hindsight, i would have preferred the "M" so i can pull it over my heel and not worry about wearing out the material over time.

COMFORT:
The fleece is very smooth and comfy.  Definitely not a thin legging that you can wear underneath a pair of skinny jeans (unfortunately!).  The pockets do add on the extra thickness.

WARMTH:
In an evening of ~50F, wearing just the leggings, socks and a pair of running shoes still left my feet feeling cold (again, don't judge the Californians..it's just me!).  I couldn't walk my dog comfortably unless i start jogging to build up the heat.  When I swapped my running shoes with a pair of Uggs/boots that gave me more coverage, it helped a lot.  I've seen reviews where people would wear it outdoor in the snow under some snow pants... i dont know if I can make the same comparison.

Overall, i just love how comfortable the pants are.  Not super expensive but also not as cheap.

reviews.title: An Interesting Mask
reviews.body:
We are preparing for our trip to Costa Rica and wanted to try a full face snorkel and this one looked pretty good.  And right out of the box and after just a couple strap changes I have to say that it is very comfortable on.  I have been reading about them and I was a little concerned about CO2 build up and problems getting the mask off in an emergency but that does not seem to be any problem.

We did run a test of the mask in the city pool and it was surprisingly free of leaks.  I did have problems with some leakage when I dove and it does seem to do better when simply cruising along the surface as the mask changes its fit when diving.  Breathing turned out to be very comfortable and the flipping snorkel was great.  We had some issues with fogging immediately (note it was in a car at 7 degree Fahrenheit and brought into a steamy indoor pool.) but that seemed to have cleared up well once the mask was warm.

Clarity was not the best.  It was definitely ok for my purposes, but there is a little distortion, especially in the bend of the lense.  It is still definitely workable but a little distorted.  I would guess there is better glass out there, but this is a pretty low price point.  It should meet our expectations for the trip, but probably will not exceed them.

-----

Reaction after the trip - There was a bit of struggling with leaks around the mask, especially along eyes and hairline.  It did fog a little, and it was hard to dive without all of these things getting a little worse.  But if I stayed on the surface and took the mask off occasionally to clear water and fog.  It worked well enough.  It was a little bulky to pack and if you are serious about your snorkeling (we did about 6 hours in six days.) you may want a better fitting mask.

reviews.title: Excellent snorkeling mask with several outstanding features
reviews.body:
I am very impressed with this snorkeling mask. The black color with blue trim is plain but looks nice. The mask has a wider field of vision than other snorkeling masks I’ve used. I like the anti-fogging feature and the way the snorkel part of the mask folds down for easier storage. There is a mesh bag that comes with the mask that can be used to store it in when not in use.

The best part about the mask is it fits over your face and you don’t have to have a separate piece that you hold in your mouth. There is also a self-draining feature just in case a wave would come in through the top piece. The mask is adjustable to make sure you get a tight fit to prevent leaks, but is also comfortable. According to the sizing, I am at the higher end of the Small/Medium, but I’m glad I got the Large/Extra Large because it fits well and there is room to adjust it to be tighter or looser as needed. This mask is definitely a step up from those I’ve used in the past.

I haven’t tried it yet, but hardware is also included in case you want to mount an underwater camera to the mask. I look forward to trying that feature in the future.

The bars that hold the weights are pretty heavy by themselves, so if you are very much out of shape, you can start with the bars alone at first; then add the lighter weights; then switch to the heavier ones and then finally both light and heavy.  There are eight weights, up to 2 for each end of each dumbbell.  The only thing I could find wrong was that the printed instructions in one place showed 3 different sizes of weights and 2 in another.  There are just 2 sizes.  These are simple enough to assemble that you don't need printed instructions anyway.  I really think you will like this set as much as I did.

reviews.title: Trilene Big Game Monofilament Custom Spool from Berkley
reviews.body: I purchased this  Berkley Trilene Big Game Monofilament Custom Spool on August 14, 2014 to use as leader.  I had several break offs recently and thought I'd up my game by using a heavier leader material.  This Trilene is a good tying material for leader to any other medium, if you use the right knot that does not crimp the line right at a stress point wrap and let the line coming from the rod tip to go down through the knot and then form the loop, or double loop, thru the swivel or hook.  Everyone has their own knot, but my breakoffs were not being tied by me at the time and I usually tie my own knots.  Over the years, I have used maybe 5 different knots regularly to tie of leader material and I feel this is as important as any aspect of the line.  Leader material will change and from now on, I'll use this and see where it takes me.  So far, not leader or knot break offs. I like it.

reviews.title: Decent Pot, Many Uses
reviews.body:
Our teakettle went the way of all such, so I bought this as a multi-functional replacement.  Obviously it doesn't whistle, but it rattles when the water boils, so it's working out as a teakettle.  The pot itself seems to be about 6" deep, which is a little less than I'd hoped, but ok.

In case you don't know, a percolator is the best pot to use for cooking whole asparagus spears.  Drop a bunch of @ 6" stalks tip-up into a pot containing enough boiling water to almost cover them. After @ 4 minutes (thickness-dependent) the tougher bottom of the stalks will soften in the hotter bottom of the pot while the tender tips steam above the bubbling upper water.

You can also make coffee in a percolator, though purists don't recommend it.  I have in-laws who prefer percolated, but I find it makes strong, acidic coffee.  The percolator apparatus is light aluminum, but I guess that's par for the course.

Twenty bucks seems like a lot for this item, which is pretty basic - as someone else says, the clasp holding the lid to the top of the kettle is a cheap stamping, but it would be as easy to bend back into shape as to bend it out of shape, so I guess it's... a VERY flexible item? ;-  Anyway, I'd rather have my money going to Mexico than China!

But I love their colors; find the cord ties nicely (although I do use a lot of strength to make sure the knots are very tight); arrives in the right time limit and I've even gone directly to their site to view the colors before ordering it through Amazon (due to factors other than price).  I will state that all paracord should be prepped first (boiled and shrunk) ... be aware that the darker solid colors may run (pink - purple - dark blue have all run) and all paracord will shrink (although I purchase enough that I'm not worried about it).  Due to the fact that the cord is made in the USA by Veterans will keep me coming back (along with the great quality of the cord): and I do like the personalized note included in each package ... it's a nice touch!

reviews.title: Don't buy it! It's an expensive piece of JUNK!
reviews.body: I purchased this cooler back in July after considerable research. I am away from home and fly frequently for my job, so I pack frozen home cooked meals to take with me. I wanted a cooler that had clasps so that I didn't have to worry about it opening during transit and would keep my food frozen for at least 5 or 6 hours. I never had a problem with food staying frozen for extended lengths of time with my previous collapsible or Igloo type coolers. The problem with the collapsible was that they don't hold up well to flight travel, and the problem with the Igloo type was that I had to tape them shut. The first time  I used the Engel Cooler, I knew I had a problem. The ice melted and there was water on the outside of the cooler when it arrived on the luggage carousel. Unfortunately, I had the cooler for several months before I used it and couldn't send it back. I continued to use it, but each time the ice melt and water leak were worse. For $60 you would expect the thing to be perfect! Instead, it's an expensive piece of JUNK! Now, one of the clasps doesn't stay shut either. It opens spontaneously, so I have to tape this piece of &*^% shut also. Buyer Beware!

reviews.title: Works with Genie 2028!
reviews.body:
Bought this during the Treasure Truck sale and received the package the next day!

My garage uses Genie 2028 and this thing worked just as expected.

Installed within 20 minutes, while 10 minutes were spent on deciding where to place the hub. The instructions in the app is very clear, literally step by step, hand by hand style to guide through every single details. It even tells you to pay attention to small things when needed.

I hate drilling so I modified the hub mounting process. I used 3M Dual Lock Reclosable Fastener instead of drilling. Basically taped them on the wall and I'm done. It took away my stress (and fear) on messing up my garage wall. The hub itself is very light so I have no problem securing it with the strong 3M tape. It uses the same mechanism as tape they provided for the sensor.

100% recommend this for the price. It's cheaper than buying garage door remotes. Also, I love the option on setting a nightly garage door closing motion in case if I didn't close it during the day. It's convenient and bonus points on having Key delivery enabled when purchasing electronics from Amazon!

Updated again 2/18/2020. Came home with a rental car today so no garage door opener in the car. Opened the My Q app only to receive a notice that there was an issue with my sensor and it needed to have button pressed on the device inside the garage. This thing is a piece of junk. Unreliable and in the time it takes to open the app I could have pressed a button on the opener inside my vehicle and got the door opened quicker.
Updated 2/7/2020. This does not consistently integrate with Alarm.com or Frontpoint and customer service is no help. By itself the MyQ app responds reliably but a HUGE PLUS would be to integrate this with my security system.  it does not integrate at all with Ring. This really does not save time when arriving or leaving the house since I have to use two different apps:one to arm/disarm my security system and another to open/shut the garage door.  Would not buy again until there is better integration with home security systems.  Alarm.com and Frontpoint said it integrates with their system but after hours on the phone over the course of several days with various customer service agents I gave up; this should not be rocket science.  Forget using Apple Home Kit with this unless you already have it the cost is astronomical.

reviews.title: Beautiful and elegant
reviews.body:
I selected this faucet for our newly remodeled kitchen with the help of a plumber, who had some excellent advice for people who like this type of faucet.  His advice was to always select a faucet with a magnetized head.  If you do not, your faucet will look great for about two months, but then gravity will exert its force, leaving the head of the faucet hanging limply from the base.  A magnet solves this problem, and the head retracts easily into the faucet base.

I also selected this faucet because I did not want more than one hole in our granite countertop.  With our previous sinks, we had three holes:  for the faucet, for the water control, and for the soap dispenser.  I fought to keep these areas clean and free of hard water stains.  With this faucet, you have one hole.  The water control is attached to the faucet and works well.  For soap, we have an attractive free-standing dispenser.  This is a matter of taste, of course, but if you like clean lines, this may be the faucet for you.  I could not be more pleased.

reviews.title: Super easy to install
reviews.body:
As soon as it arrived I called the plummer. 60 minutes after he arrived, at a cost of a little under $100, they replaced the original kitchen sink faucet that was 15 years old. It looks spectacular and works to perfection. I truly could not be happier. I played with it for about 10 minutes - I have a double sink and it swivels easily and smoothly.

The light at the base that shows blue when the water is cold and red when the water gets hot is a really nice feature.

Also, I asked the plumbers what they have in their home and they said Delta or Moen are the only way to go - winner!

The BEST part is the touch function. I can't exaggerate the number of times while cooking that my hands were full or unclean and I didn't want to get the handle dirty too. Now I will be able to use an elbow or back of a hand and the water will start - WINNER.

At the same time, if there's certain ones you switch between regularly, the rear of the screwdriver actually opens up and lets you store the bits inside. The handle is easy and ergonomic, and the switch to ratchet direction or locked is intuitive. I'll be honest, my old ratcheting screwdriver was just a basic one that came with one of those black rubber holders for the bits (which always gets lost when I need it). Between the tilting case and storage int he handle, I'm sold on this one! It's a very handy and well made tool.

It's only $1.39, so I guess I can't complain too much. but It's not what I expected.

The nice thing about the weathered look is it doesn't matter how many mistakes I made it looks even better.  This stain also worked with a can of Dap wood putty I found that is over 20 yrs. old. I added acetone to the putty and it reconstituted the putty. The stain does not look glossy either. I would have not liked anything shiny. I made an india ink wash to antique the pine wood before I used the stain.

reviews.title: Good, but wish it had a dial/ reset to most recently used settings
reviews.body:
I tried this out for replacing the back glass of a Galaxy s8 phone that my cat pushed off a ledge.

The product itself is physically well designed and works as advertised. It comes with some attachments for altering the air flow, but they are just bent sheet metal, so they vastly increase the surface area with which to burn yourself. It comes with an end cap, but I tossed it when I found the device would run with it on, which seems really hazardous. It seems like it should either be blown out, trigger a shutdown, or prevent startup.

Fixing the phone went well, except that this thing seems to reset to default settings after it has been off for a few minutes. When I took short breaks, everything was fine, but when I came back from a lunch break, it had quietly reset itself to its default, something like 650F, which I didn't notice until I nearly scorched the phone. It's things like this that make me want to buy something with a dial. I assume most people would be preferring it to default to the most recent setting.

Overall, very glad to have this for the inevitable repairs needed in a household of geeks.

The expense of LED bulbs come with a warranty of about 50K hours of service, but having one quit working causes me to wonder. reviews.title: Love this!!!
reviews.body: After reading many reviews on many different shower heads, I bought this one. I have only replaced one simple shower head before so I was a little nervous to install it. There are a lot of complaints about it being plastic, and yes most of it is plastic. It looks great though and feels very substantial/sturdy. The fact that it is plastic does not bother me. The first thing I did was watch a YouTube video on how to remove the water flow restrictor. I then removed it with needle nose pliers, and It came out easily. I installed the shower head in about 10 minutes. I had a small leak where the shower head meets the shower arm, so I took it off, wrapped the shower arm with some thread seal tape, and replaced the shower head. Voila!!! No more leak!!! I really wish people would troubleshoot  before leaving negative reviews. The water pressure is amazing after taking out the flow restrictor. I don’t know what it’s like otherwise. When I ordered this product, I also ordered an 8” shower arm due to reading the complaints about the shower head hitting the wall. I did not have to use it. It worked fine on my shorter shower arm that was already there. The magnet on the handheld part is very strong. I am writing this review after using this for several months, and the magnet hasn't failed me yet. I am very happy with this product. It works great, and I haven’t had any problems with it over the several months I have used it!

reviews.title: Truly a SMART DEVICE that could SAVE YOUR LIFE!
reviews.body:
[[VIDEOID:18a030dbc1dd0d3cbadd30a44c8e7568]] While I have nearly 50 smart devices in use around my house none of them are as potentially life saving as this one.

First Alert has really hit a home run with this product in my opinion.

The unit comes with everything you will need to easily install this hard wired smoke and carbon monoxide detector.  I am not real handy and it took me well under an hour to: remove my old smoke detector, replace the mounting bracket, add the power adapter (which was the hardest part because while the adapter fit correctly the plastic tabs on the sides of my original plug were larger than the adapter holes), mount the Onelink, sync with the app and Apple Home Kit and set it up.

I had absolutely no issue with the Onelink connecting to my home network, the app or my Amazon Alexa account.

The microphone picks up incredibly well when using the Alexa functionality. The microphone can be easily turned off within the app for anyone with privacy concerns.

The nightlight will auto adjust its brightness depending on the ambient light and can be set to any color.  It’s cool that it illuminates in rhythm when Alexa speaks or music plays.

While I noticed other reviewers found the sound from the speaker underwhelming, I found mine really exceptional for what it is.  Music sounds rich and clear.

Currently the speaker can not be synced with other echos for whole house or multi-room music. I’ve researched this and First Link is working on an update that will allow for this.

I’m sure that First Link will continue to improve the software within the Onelink’s onboard memory and their functionality will broaden and improve.

I ran a test of the smoke and carbon monoxide detector by pressing the button and the alarm is extremely loud.  The voice is clear and states that there is a fire or carbon monoxide present in the (room that you’ve assigned the Onelink).  If carbon monoxide is detected it lets you know what the level is in parts per million.

I think this is an awesome smart device that is wise investment for any family.  It will protect you in case of emergencies and it will entertain you all the rest of the time.

reviews.title: Easy to install and love all the built in features!
reviews.body:
I ordered the First Alert Onelink Safe & Sound - Smart Hardwired Smoke + Carbon Monoxide Alarm and Premium Home Speaker with Amazon Alexa, 2-pack to replace some very old smoke detectors in our home. Installing these was pretty easy and straightforward and once installed, the App was also easy to set up and connect to both devices. We have a total of 8 Smoke Alarms in our home that are all linked together. Recently we replaced one of them with another model Onelink and now two others with these, and they all still work together when testing the new ones. Once one goes off, they all chime in.

The integrated Alexa is awesome (and works great by the way), but don’t expect the speakers to sound any better than maybe a higher end portable speaker. Don’t get me wrong, the speakers do work and sound quite well for what they are, and produce a nice clean sound - but at volume 10 listening to music, I notice some distortion. Normally I keep both speakers set to volume 7 and that suits our needs just fine to play some background music while doing laundry or working in the kitchen or family room.

The night light feature is really nice and fun to play with the different colors and brightness levels. This will hopefully come in handy as we try to wean my youngest daughter from having to keep the hallway lights on all the time at night. I do love the fact that within the App you can set these to automatically adjust the brightness according to your daytime lighting. This feature is not available on the other Onelink device that we recently installed.

Overall I am very happy with this pair of high-tech Smoke detectors and feel much safer having replaced some very old and basic smoke detectors with these that not only detect smoke, but also Carbon Monoxide AND include Auto dimming night lights, Alexa and nice sounding speakers.

reviews.title: A useful reading lamp with a few design issues
reviews.body:
I'm not very coordinated, but by relying on the little mnemonic my husband taught me, "righty tighty, lefty loosey," I had no trouble putting this LED reading lamp together. It also helped that this is a very lightweight lamp that is easy to pick up and move around.

It has three metal bars that form its pole, and it is up to the individual consumer how tall to make this lamp. It can either be short enough to place on top of a desk, or a little bit higher for sitting on a bedside table, or the maximum height as a floor lamp.

Note that, at its tallest level, it is not as high by at least 2 feet as a regular floor lamp. I assume that's because it is meant to only be used for reading or working on craft projects while sitting in a chair, rather than potentially as a standard floor lamp for lighting a room as well. It has a very bright, concentrated light in contrast to a typical floor lamp, which softly and diffusely lights up a whole room.

The entire design of this lamp is sleek, modern and attractive, other than the ugly power cord that spoils the otherwise appealing appearance of the lamp.

I would myself would have much preferred that this lamp have the type of pole and base through which the power cord could have been threaded in order to prevent the unsightly mass of thin, spidery cord that hangs all over it. With a bit more attention to design, this could have been easily possible, because the multiple parts of the pole are all hollow. But because of the way the cord hangs off the top, gooseneck part of the lamp, there is no possible way that the cord could fit inside the pole. At least, however, this lamp comes with three little plastic hooks that attach to the pole and grip the cord, holding it close to the pole. Unfortunately, however, the cord is extremely long, so I had to accordion-fold at least half of it and use the black twist-tie that came with the cord to secure it a little less untidily than allowing it to sprawl all over the floor.

The design of the power plug that goes with the cord is very different than what is standard in the USA, so I am assuming this lamp is foreign made. The cord has a prong on its end that must be inserted into a separate short cord that hangs off the power plug.

As advertised, this lamp has a dimmer switch so that the user can control the brightness of the light. Its gooseneck also works very well.

Overall, this is a decent reading lamp that many consumers will find quite useful.

reviews.body:
This is a good hardwired smoke detector that connects with most systems. Its only problem is that the latching feature doesn't always work, so sometimes you get a nuisance alarm and can't find where it was.

Nuisance alarms are usually an indicator of a dying back-up battery or an approaching expiration date. However, if you are getting repeated nuisance alarms with a new unit, try cleaning and resetting it once and only once. If it's still bad, send it back.

reviews.title: Didn't Work For Us
reviews.body: This unit is easy to install. Which is good because unless yo program it before you hang it you will have to take it down and start over again. however installation was simple. We replaced an old unit that was in the hallway. Although it was in proximity to the main bath and not too far from the kitchen, I didn't expect things like steam and minor cooking fumes to trigger it. But it did. I am not talking billowing clouds of smoke or steam but just regular cooking fumes. As for the bath, it is off the main corridor. Having the door shut all the time was a solution. But this unit did give false alarms at night. It is deafening loud. My mother is not in the best of health and this served to upset her as well as disrupting her (and the rest of the household's) sleep. It happened without rhyme or reason. After the third time, I just removed it. Perhaps placing it elsewhere would be a remedy. It is a good idea and I liked the battery back up. we never had a problem with our previous unit and frankly, I don't want to go through the hassle of relocating it just to go through annoyances. It does seem well made and the connectivity is a plus.

reviews.title: For the lazy socket mechanic ... me.

Cutting the stand-up-and-sit-down multi-trips to the sockets for that one size you forgot is over. The fit over English or metric is good enough for everything I've run into so far. I do use an organized drill drive set for 1/2" and smaller. This is meant for larger sizes.

There is no doubt that you will need the exact right size socket for precision and strip/torque tricky work. But, those occasions are maybe like 10% of nuts and bolts I run into around the house. The 20v drill driven multi-fit socket suits 90% of the housework.

reviews.title: As advertised, value for money

reviews.title: Wide, long, stable support.  This is a heck of a lot better than I expected.
reviews.body:
I've had other workout benches and was rather worried to get one online.  I am almost shocked at how great this thing is.

Putting it together took me minutes.  Less than a dozen screws that come with their own set of allen wrenches.  All you need a pair of pliers (there are 2 nots & bolts).

This is nice, wide, padded but firm and comfortable.  And unlike my previous ones, my head is neither hanging or resting on the edge (I'm 6' tall 220 lb).  There is no wobble, nothing rattles or in anyway loose, except the padded feet support (the part that sticks out and would hold your legs for situps), that has a fraction of an inch wiggle room.

I would have bought the 3 position one that's about $100 cheaper, but I really wanted the leg support for sit-ups and it wasn't completely clear if that one came with it, though some of reviewers said it did.  I feel the 5 settings is a waste on me, I only use the single most reclined (basically flat) one.

Excellent bench.  Really the best I've ever used or seen.  Couldn't be happier!

ps.  It does have that "smokey" plastic smell.  A month later, it still makes my room smell like it.  But it is SLOWLY getting less.

reviews.title: Bigger than my Chiweenie pup, and he LOVES it!
reviews.body:
UPDATE: Oh, the poor little Bandit! Bandit has been Bingo's security blanket, humping companion, BFF, and "only other dog in the house" until we got a real-live lifewire little dog, Doobie, who is a Jack Chi. Doobie is one high-energy chewing fool. Doobie has gotten up inside of Bandit and pulled his guts out of his butt and also chewed his eyes out, leaving holes. Bingo is not happy and so is trying to tug his dear Bandit away from Doobie, so I knew Bandit was not going to be long for the world. I ordered a new Bandit for Bingo, and he is thrilled, but I'm going to have to put him up until Doobie is over his puppy stage. But this Bandit racoon puppet is a fantastic purchase for a little dog.

ORIGINAL REVIEW: Move over Gator. Hit the box, Fox. Bandit has arrived.

Our 10-week-old Chiweenie puppy wants to bite-shake play, and even though he's careful not to be too vicious with DH's hand, he was breaking the skin. I got this puppet as a way to protect us from those sharp little puppy teeth.

Bingo went nuts for Bandit, and we did, too. On my hand, I don't like the fit on my thumb, which tends to slide out of the arm, but it seems to be fine on DH's larger hand. I just lift Bandit by the back and march him up and down, and the puppet is floppy enough, but also firm enough, to seem like a living critter.

I can't emphasize enough how nice the contrast between his nose and white snout is. When we say "bite his nose," he goes right for that little black nose. The nose and the eyes are sewn in very well so I don't worry so much about our dog pulling them off and choking them. Another thing really nice about this puppet is that it has some movement to it even when we are not assisting him in playing with it. He will pick it up and shake it, carry it around like it's his prize possession (which is funny, because it's bigger than he is), and put it in his "room" (a small rug) with his collection of squirrels and such.

UPDATE: Oh, Bandit is such a hit! Bingo sleeps with Bandit, pees on Bandit, madly humps Bandit, chases him all over the house when we throw him, carries him proudly to show "Bingo too" in the mirror, jumps up into the back of the loveseat in the living room with Bandit so Bandit can look out the window with Bingo at the neighbors passing by. Bandit has had to go in the washing machine quite a few times now, and with vicious chiweenie tug-of-war play, poor Bandit's scalp is starting to come unsewn. I can sew him up by hand and he'll be fine, but I'm already thinking I'd better get another Bandit to have on hand for when Bingo's BFF is in complete shreds! Bandit has shrunk some with washing, so it's hard to get a large adult hand into him, but he's still more than doing his job. He and Bingo now are about the same size. Bingo's eight months old and seven pounds.

reviews.title: Does not hold up, confusing toy design while charging.
reviews.body:
This hatchimal is huge! The crystal home for her is much larger than I expected. It looks really pretty in the crystal container.

When I opened it up 4 of us had a hard time reading the instructions and figuring out how to plug her in to start charging (the charge port is located on her skirt...not the base of the crystal structure). I don't like that she has a stand on the base of the crystal for charging but you can't put the lid on at the same time or it cuts the charge cord. Would have been a nice design detail if there was a hole at the bottom of the top part of the crystal that would fit the cable so I dont have this extra part of the toy sitting around.

There is an on/off switch on her skirt. Once she is turned on you hold her in your hand and she is supposed to start flying. I have issues getting her to start sometimes and have to move my hand underneath the skirt a few times for her to recognize it and start flying. I don't recommend her for indoor use, seems much better and can get a lot more fly time outside in a park than indoors where she will quickly hit a wall or furniture and stop flying. After I pick her up, she will not fly for me again without turning her on and off again. It does hurt to stop her in the air by using your hands. One time this flew into my daughters head and caused a bruise, the wings are hard and hurt more than you would expect.

The next day we tried to use her again but the little bars around her skirt now hit her arms for some reason and stop flying. Nothing happened to her in between us using her the day before. I would have been frustrated if I purchased this toy for $30 to only get one day of use out of it.

Overall my daughter loves this toy and her crystal house and had a lot of fun on the first day of play, the second day of play she was really sad and frustrated that she couldn't get her to fly properly again.  Honestly, the coolest thing about this toy is the packaging, My children played for them for maybe two days before losing interest.

There is a button on the bottom that turns on the Pixie. You hold her in your hand, raise your hand a little, and her wings begin to spin. She then takes off and flies!

She flies well, however she only lasts about 10 minutes before having to charge her again.

reviews.title: Absolutely get this!!!
reviews.body:
Oh boy, I can't tell you how much my children (6 & 9) LOVE this toy!!! Be warned, this doll causes endless giggling!
She's crashed a hundred times already and had held up so far. And believe me, if a toy has a weak spot, my children will find it. And break it. Every time.
Also know th instructions and warnings only look overwhelmimg at first; but in the end were easy enough to navigate and understand. In reality, it's only about a dozen sentences printed in 18 different languages (both in the manual and in the outside). So it only looks like a lot of text at first. It took less than 5 minutes to open her and figure things out.
The only thing I'm not loving so far is the power supply cord. I'm not a fan of any item that comes with its own, uncommon charging device (because if the power supply gets lost or broken, now so is the toy). And it's really short cord, which limited the places around the house we could plug her in to. And as much as my daughter wanted to do it by herself, she was unable to wrap the cord back into it's spot in the bottom of the base.
Beyond the minor cord issues, I can't recommend this toy enough. Don't forget to keep her away from a lit fireplace though, lol.

reviews.title: Cute toys, great use of letter and color recognition.
reviews.body: These have been so much fun to discover with my 2.5yo granddaughter. I love the color coordination - the color of the letter, color of the acorn top, and color of the item all match. This has provided a whole other way to use these while we play (ie: sorting, color recognition). I also love that the upper case of the letter is on the outside, and the lower case is on the inside of the acorn top. I see some reviewers commenting on the choice of items for each letter, and while some feel a little odd/non-traditional, I don't see it as a big issue. Two reasons I deducted a star for this rating: (1) the acorn tops do not stay on when these are placed in a bag - and how else do you expect to store or transport these? Every time we try to put these away, it just become a salad of toys, acorns, and tops. (2) These smell _horrible_ for a while after unpacking - like, 2 or 3 days of airing them out before the odor didn't hit the back of our throats. Because of this, I recommend opening them before you give them to your child.

reviews.title: Good in theory.. but, falls short entertaining!!
reviews.body:
Great in size, stability and theory.. this has a solid idea going for it- Problem is, it falls way flat in the sheer lack of components made to entertain! It’s not that anything is wrong with what’s included.. it just lacks so much possible activity which could’ve made this so right.. It lacks what is needed to hold a little ones attention and keep them engaged!!

This is 3 larger double sided page/boards that barely have x1 minuscule activity per side which doesnt add up- bc, Fisher Price is usually spot on with their target audience! Ex. if you see my photos above: x1 entire board (16x20) is designated to a sliding car that moves 1” side to side.. another has a small vent that slides up/down 1”…?? I included photo with cute animal shape in cut out window.. but, it does nothing!!? You see- many opportunities missed!

Plus side, bright colors attract attention, whimsical sounds can be started by a button- (it just has to be pushed repeatedly to continue) Our 16mo. old quickly bounces around each board looking for any fun to grab his attention.. besides the 3 block fit in shapes.. he’s done within minutes. At a $40 price point, I am afraid this misses the mark.

Where I see this best suited is for the infant trying to go mobile.. crawling or standing- this can help support or draw them in! Otherwise, i’m not sure it will live up to expectations. Note: This can fold and store within itself to a smaller footprint- that’s always a plus! Hoping this info can help your decision- stay safe.
